entityDescription:
Fly4Future company designs new technologies of aerial robotics and searches new ways of applying AI technologies onboard of unmanned systems. Our expertise includes precise control of unmanned systems, trajectory planning and following, operation in GPS and GPS denied environment, flying in indoor, outdoor and transition between these environments, onboard sensors fusion, environment mapping, scanning, and 3D modelling. In particular, we design technologies of autonomous take-off and precise landing from/on moving vehicles, cooperative deployment of multiple systems, precision agriculture, security applications, autonomous reconnaissance and surveillance. Representatives of Fly4future company have a long-term experience with R&D projects of drone research and development, including H2020 EU projects, EU operational program projects, Czech Technology agency projects, Czech science foundation, Czech ministries of Industry and Trade, Education, and Culture projects.

Two main business pillars of Fly4Future company are 1) Development and prototyping of autonomous aerial systems, and 2) Customized platforms for UAV research and development. 

In the first pillar, Fly4Future designs and develops autonomous drone systems specialized for particular needs of individual industrial end-users. Our solutions enable to deploy aerial robots in demanding outdoor and indoor workspace. Using onboard artificial intelligence, advanced computer vision, predictive control, and cutting-edge sensors and effectors, our aerial robots can be deployed close to obstacles in various tasks including even physical interaction with the environment. We offer a complete chain from a proof of concept of the most innovative ideas in cooperation with leading universities, over development of prototypes using state-of-the-art technologies, into a final product for your business.

Examples of autonomous drone applications we are focused on are:
Autonomous reconnaissance and surveillance,
precision agriculture, animals' localization,
security applications, convoys protection, moving objects pursuing,
aerial inspection of buildings interiors and industrial infrastructure,
inside inspection of pipelines, underground mines, caves, 
autonomous take-off and landing on moving vehicles (cars, boats, trains),
operation in GPS and GPS denied environment and transition between these environments,
precise control of unmanned systems using onboard sensor fusion,
environment mapping, scanning, and 3D modelling etc.

In the second pillar, Fly4Future builds unmanned aerial vehicles and systems of multiple aerial vehicles suited for requirements of research teams at universities as well as private companies worldwide. Our solution enables to integrate set of sensors of your choice into a ready-to-fly system accompanied with realistic simulators. To achieve maximally open and flexible research platform, our flagship products rely on open source controllers and ROS, but other systems can be integrated on request too. The key components of the delivered systems include precise control, onboard mission planning and multi-robot communication which makes possible to use the provided solutions for verification of multi-UAV and swarm robotics research. If required, we offer on-site training, assistance with experiments and even realization experiments on demand with our hardware. 

Our platforms are ready-to-fly to verify research achievements in the field of:
Swarms and multi-robot systems, visual tracking, navigation and learning,
deep learning and adaptive systems,
localization and mapping,
human-aerial robot interaction,
aerial manipulation, environment interaction, and grasping,
indoor navigation and localization,
field outdoor deployment in demanding conditions,
tactile and force sensing,
heterogenous UAV-UGV and UAV-AUV teams,
perception, onboard sensors verification, sensor fusion,
UAV control and state estimation etc.

entityDescription:
The Istituto per le Tecnologie Didattiche (ITD) is one of the research institutes of the Italian National Research Council. The institute is devoted to the study of educational innovation brought about through the use of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT). The research undertaken focuses on:
- the integration of ICT in various educational settings (school, university, business)
- issues related to different disciplines and themes (humanities, sciences, environmental education, etc.)
- learning issues of particular social significance (disability, learning difficulties, social disadvantage, intercultural issues, etc.)
- the study of technological innovation as a learning resource.
The main areas of reference for the Institute's research work are the cognitive sciences, computer science and the pedagogy of the various disciplines.

entityDescription: Telenavis S.A is a Greek SME, established in October 2000 in Athens, with the mission to provide innovative location intelligence, by developing software solutions that utilize the technologies of the global positioning through satellites (GPS, Galileo), the internet in the broad definition of connecting all the devices, the telematic devices and their wide range of sensors, and finally the smart phones as a way of connecting people. Telenavis S.A is a dynamically active company in the field of Geographic Information Systems and develops its activities in three main areas: • Digital Mapping. The aim is the collection, quality control and the digital imprint thus recording the information concerning the geography of Greece using advanced image sensing satellite technologies, etc. • Software development. The company utilizes its extensive experience and highly qualified executives to incorporate geographic data into applications for businesses and individuals. • Development of specialized applications. To provide efficient services to customers who want to have an integrated solution, Telenavis SA designs and implements cutting-edge desktop and mobile applications that meet the customer’s needs in all aspects of geographic information. Telenavis has developed a number of different products and services, introducing new ways for planning and executing everyday business in logistics, in salesforce automation, in service providers, in Municipalities. Our clients cover different sectors, like: Fast Moving Consumer Goods, Logistics, Retail Companies, Transportation, Banks, Telecommunications, Utilities, Pharmaceuticals, Public and Local Authorities. The main products and services are: 1. TLP – Telenavis Logistics Platform A platform that covers the freight transportation from planning to execution, collaborative, providing full visibility during the total journey. 2. SRP – Telenavis School Route Platform. A platform for planning monitoring and executing the everyday journey to school and back, providing information to parents. 3. GIS Services (Geomarketing, Site Selection, Web Mapping). Big data analytics on maps. 4. Telenavis SmartCity Platform. A platform that supports local governments to plan and manage their areas, assets and services, and communicate with their citizens. The majority of the workforce at Telenavis SA holds degrees and postgraduate titles in innovative technologies, telecommunications, telematics and geographical information systems.

(Information Technology) with environmental expertise. TerrAria currently
consists of close-knit and multidisciplinary team of 20 employees with
articulated competences (IT experts, computer engineers, physicists,
environmental and energetic engineers and urban planners) and able to provide
expert consultancy to Public Authorities, Research Facilities and private
operators about environmental and energy planning, strategic and impact
assessments and design and development of ad hoc sw-applications, through a
long-term approach oriented to environmental, economic and social
sustainability. Since its founding, TerrAria has increased employees and
turnover with a constant growth rate to current 20 employees and 1500 k € of
turnover.
TerrAria is organized in three Business Units:
(1) Software design and development: giving
priority to open-source software development, TerrAria is a leader in developing
WebGIS solutions and J2EE applications based on complex systems that manage and
provide information with business intelligence and databases (Oracle,
PostgreSQL, MySQL...) 
(2) Governance and environmental and
energy-environmental models: evaluates the interaction between project
scenarios and environment, through the implementation of forecasting models and
energy-environmental balances.
(3) Research and Development: due to its own
multi-knowledge attitude, TerrAria is often involved in research and development
projects, both as coordinator, partner and subcontractor. The most recent
research and development projects co-founded by EU or Regional funds are:
IRIS-LIFE project to improve the resilience of industry sector to climate
change (http://www.lifeiris.eu/en/), 
UTAQ an Urban Tool for Air Quality a CAMS-ECMWF use case,
SIMULATOR-ADS a regional/EU FESR funding an IT-platform to support the Civil
Protection prevention and preparedness also through satellite images

skills and the company's business thanks to a high-level expertise and through
an innovative mission that allows to understand the market needs in advance.

- since 2016 TerrAria has entered into the special section of the Commercial
Register of companies as innovative SME

Communities (currently being in the Board) and Lombardy and Energy

for the integrated management urban-scale systems and underground.

entityDescription:
The Passive House Institute was established in 1996 as an independent research institute in Darmstadt, Germany. Having developed the concept of cost effective Passive Houses, the Institute has gathered many years of experience in the field of research, simulation, quality assurance, design, implementation, project support, monitoring and evaluation, training and dissemination in the field of Passive House buildings and deep retrofits (EnerPHit). Moreover, the Institute gives recommendations how the Passive House and EnerPHit Standards can be used as a universal basis for the implementation of high energy efficiency directives across the globe, for example, the Nearly Zero Energy Buildings (NZEBs).

Having been active since 1996 under the name of Passive House Institute Dr. Wolfgang Feist, the institute is currently transitioning its activities to a new legal form as an important step to successfully and sustainably continue its work in the future. Under the registered company name "Passivhaus Institut GmbH" (PHI), which is owned and run by long-term Passive House Institute staff, the same team of scientists, engineers and consultants is working to continue research, consultation, certification or dissemination activities to advancing the organizations fundamental goal of making the built environment more sustainable.

It carries out research across the full spectrum of emergency management, risk analysis, planning and response, including the PULSE project aimed at the Development of decision support tools for improving preparedness and response of Health Services involved in emergency situations. Also the S-HELP project which was focused on the development of Decision Support Tools for Improving Preparedness and Response of Health Services Involved in Emergency Situations.
ICEM has provided consultancy to EU Projects, Office of An Taoiseach, national and local government etc.
ICEM has a fully equipped TV production studio and outside broadcast facilities, the ability to stream live in HD on protected websites, including password protection for access to viewing, events such as emergency management exercises, business presentations, etc. 
ICEM has produced emergency management training and training media for many local authorities, national government and EU projects, all media is recorded in HD and made available on memory sticks, DVD disks, Blu-Ray disks and also via a streaming protected server as required.

entityDescription:
D-Heart biomedical start-up was founded in 2015 thanks to the work of Nicolò Briante and Niccolò Maurizi, at the time two young students in the interdisciplinary environment of the Almo Collegio Borromeo of Pavia. Maurizi is a young doctor researcher in cardiology at the University of Florence. When he was sixteen, Maurizi was hit by a myocardial infarction. He decided to became a doctor and transform his problem into an opportunity. Thanks to the help and business expertise of his roommate, Briante, they created D-Heart, the first smartphone/tablet ECG device that combines the usability required by the patient and reliability of the ECG wanted by the doctor.
It allows to patients and health professionals to perform hospital-grade 8/12 lead ECGs in total autonomy and to send the exam to a telecardiology service active 24/7. In few minutes a cardiologist will report the exam and send the telereport directly to the smarphone/tablet of the user and via email. The ECG can also be shared with anyone (for example with your trusted physician) via email or WhatsApp or message.

Quantitas is a tech company which develops decision support systems in high-complexity contexts, creating tools and setting itself a challenge: implementing new methods to collect, analyze, visualize, and disseminate information. Quantitas invests a substantial part of its work in research and development, promoting activities and events regarding Big Data exploration and development.
Quantitas helps give value to research results providing companies and study centers with advanced reporting tools and products which have interactive modes and captivating data animation with great impact on presentations and displays.

Quantitas extacts information from your data
Quantitas extacts actionable information. It acquires, processes, and models data, producing directions, instructions / and guidelines which can be immediately interpreted and used by company management. Quantitas was born to provide services and products within the entire data management process: its scientists have the appropriate experience, competences, and talent for any type of challenge in the field of Big Data analysis.

Quantitas increases the value of your data
Quantitas acquires your data to extract all their information potential, thanks to design, interaction, animation, and graphics. In today’s world where companies, research institutes, and institutions present their data using the same old-fashioned ways such as motionless dashboards or slides, or spreadsheet charts, Quantitas offers solutions capable of creating a real entertainment experience for both the most expert analysts and laypeople.

We believe in research and innovation!
We develop methods of Big Data analysis and synthesis. Q-Science is an open research space which generates methodology solutions, proof-of-principle contributions, and scientific publications. Besides traditional data sources (company databases, samples, and panels) our target is Big Data (social, open, linked, sensing). The innovative solutions we propose involve Big Data sampling techniques, analysis of complex network structures, information recovery from non-structured data, decision support systems, visualization tools.

entityDescription: THE DRONE OFFICE is a consulting and services company specialising in drones, based in London and Paris. We offer public and private clients independent, solution-agnostic expertise. Drone consulting Drones are part of the autonomous vehicle transformation and our first objective is to help clients develop a safe and innovative drone roadmap. Drones are also part of the digital transformation. So beyond safety, our objective is to help clients transform disruption into a competitive advantage and value creation. Equally important, we share with clients a vision of technology with a sense of purpose, that truly adds value for everyone. Our services cover the building and updating our client’s inhouse expertise and foundation knowledge; assessing the state-of-the-art in their industry; pilot-project design and planning; support to the selection of technologies, suppliers, and partners; project management; scaling-up from pilot-project to routine operations. Fly2Care: medical drone delivery Medical drone delivery of biological samples, vaccines, blood units, or medical equipment is still in its infancy. Clearly, the ability to bypass ground infrastructure, either because it is too congested, or because it is deficient or non-existent, is a powerful lever for transformation. Several experiments are already underway around the planet, especially in the medical field with the support of UNICEF. We believe that the use of drones, first in remote places then in an urban environment, has the potential to transform access to care.

entityDescription:
IS-Wireless develops and delivers 5G networking solutions. These include standard-compliant software and hardware necessary to build 5G (and also 4G) telco networks by MNO, MVNOs, private institutions, municipalities and many more.
5G is understood here not only as one of the 3GPP releases (5G NR) but, primarily, as a new paradigm needed for the coming networking revolution, where better performance is delivered at a lower cost. This cannot be done by just copying the network architectures and business models from previous generations (2G, 3G, 4G). The new approach is necessary, where network functionality is fully software-defined (i.e., virtualized) and can be run on any COST hardware. What follows, such new network infrastructure can be offered in models known to software industry, such as SaaS (or rather Infrastructure-as-a-Service).
IS-Wireless specializes in software solutions for the Radio Access Network (RAN) part, which is the most costly, cross-disciplinary and challenging part of telecom network. 1000x higher capacity can only be provided with a much denser RAN network, where spectrum is reused aggressively by numerous low-power low-cost Radio Heads. Interference problems need to be solved, QoS needs to be provided and all these should happen at a lower network CAPEX and OPEX. This makes RAN the critical part of 5G.
IS-Wireless is strongly rooted in R&D on 4G and 5G. In 2006 the company started operation and provided a complete design of special-purpose broadband access system for one of the providers of Polish MOD. In 2009 the company started experimenting with 4G software implementations focusing on PHY and MAC layers. In 2012 IS-Wireless started participation in EU-funded collaborative projects on 5G, with partners such as Alcatel-Lucent, Intel, Atos, Fraunhofer Institute and many more. In 2018 IS-Wireless received Round-A funding for work on software-defined 5G networking (including RAN, core and MANO).

entityName: Sapienza University of Rome - Dipartimento di Sanità Pubblica e Malattie Infettive
entityDescription: Today, health and medical achievements have brought life expectancy at birth from 47 years of 1900 to almost 80 in 2000. Despite this, there are significant differences within the population in terms of quality of life, health, access to healthcare services and assistance received. Even worse differences lie between the developed and developing countries. Even these last differences are only apparently distant from our world, in fact they are closely related to us because of the intense migration flows. All this adds up to the usual problems related to the study and control of environmental contamination (water, food, atmospheric air, indoor air, work environment); to the fight against the ancient and new infectious agents; to control of the social and health consequences of chronic-degenerative pathologies; to the new ways of producing and using food, the need to address the challenge of new ways of organizing and managing health services, consistent with budget constraints with the need to ensure efficiency, effectiveness of health interventions. The main objective of the Department is to offer the academic world and civil society a response to these problems and a center of study and control of all the factors that can affect the individual and collective health of the people. To achieve this goal, knowledge is needed from different professional and specialized skills, better developed and operating in multidisciplinary integrated model. The Department of Public Health and Infectious Diseases "G. Sanarelli" is thus an instrument that combines research and didactic-training activities related to epidemiology, prevention, planning and organization of health services.

entityDescription:
Smartmicrooptics (SMO) is a start-up company, spin-off of the Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia, with the mission to provide everyone with the tools to explore the microworld.
SMO develops and manufactures mini-optics and systems for portable and affordable microscopy. It has developed two products family, called Blips and DIPLE, based on different patent applications. Blips was launched in the market with a very successful reward crowdfunding on Kickstarter in 2016; DIPLE, currently in advanced state of development, has been launched with great success on Kickstarter too, in late 2019.
SMO has 132 shareholders, as result of an equity crowdfunding performed in early 2019. SMO is 100% owner of SMO-US, its subsidiary in the US established in late 2019 for expanding its market share in North America.
Since its foundation in 2016, SMO has manufactured and sold more than 80,000 lenses. Its current products are addressed both the B2C and B2B markets. The clients of SMO are mainly Science fans, Schools/Science teachers, pharma companies, technicians and professionals needing portable systems for microscopy applications.
One SMO's medium-term goal is to develop portable devices for point-of-care diagnostics/tele-medicine, starting from the current systems; collaborations with doctors in the fields of pathology, urology and dermatology have already been established.

entityDescription:
Ayuda en Acción (AeA) is an independent, non-political and non-confessional Spanish development cooperation organization aimed to promote structural changes to contribute to the eradication of poverty. It works to improve the living conditions of the most disadvantaged communities through self-sustaining development programmes.
AeA has 38 years of experience in proposal design, planning, managing and implementing development projects. Currently, our work is supported by more than 105,000 collaborators and 645 companies and public institutions, as well as volunteer personnel, who contribute to the work that the organization implements in 18 countries in Latin America, Asia, Africa and also in Spain and Portugal. We promote more than 120 cooperation and integral development programmes that improve the living conditions of more than 2 million people who suffer, or are at risk of suffering, poverty, inequality and social exclusion. In compliance with its internal policies, it promotes equal opportunities for men and women in its labour structure; thus, at the close of this financial year, 55% of the workforce and 40% of decision-making positions are held by women.
Ayuda en Acción recognizes rights holders in all persons and works with others so that they can exercise their rights fully and on their own. It promotes and accompanies public and private programmes to enable people to develop, within their communities and in an organized and collective manner, the capacities that will enable them to equip themselves with the means to exercise basic rights, such as the right to education, the right to health and the right to food.
The volume of investment for 2018 was almost 36 million euros, distributed as follows 82.6% from private funds (members' funds, fair trade sales, business collaborations such as Google, Accenture, Ferrovial, REPSOL and La Caixa, among others) and 17.4% from public funds, including various multilateral organizations (European Union, UNDP, OCHA, FAO, WFP, UNICEF), Spanish public administrations (AECID, AACID, various city councils such as Madrid, Barcelona, Bilbao), and European donors such as the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation (SDC) and the German government.

swyMe commercialize swyMed and swyMeet.
swyMed is the only Live Video Medicine platform built specifically for healthcare providers who want to provide high-quality care to their patients even in the most challenging network conditions.

Live Video Medicine (LVM) is telemedicine provided through a real-time audio and video connection between one or more medical professionals and a patient. Over the last five years, the use of LVM has been slowly introduced in pre-hospital care, ambulatory or clinic care, and home settings for conditions that require, among other things, a rapid visual assessment (Critical Care and Emergency Medicine) or a strong patient-doctor relationship (mental illnesses or chronic conditions—diabetes, heart failure, COPD). Over 230 million patients in the USA alone suffer from diseases that can be treated through LVM and the cost for treating such diseases is expected to more than double over the next 15 years from $700 billion today to almost $1.5 trillion by 2030 if left unchecked. Live video medicine will fundamentally change the way health care providers work. swyMed is the most effective Live Video Medicine solution available on the market today.

entityDescription:
Fundación Cibervoluntarios is a non-profit organization shaped by social entrepreneurs that promote the use and knowledge of new technologies as a means to alleviate social gaps, generate social innovation and foster citizen empowerment. 
We were born in December 2001 and, after 3 years as an Association, in 2005 we became a Foundation under the protectorate of the Ministry of Culture of the Spanish Government. We have been working for 19 years with a main goal: to empower people through the social use of ICTs, thanks to a growing network of social and technological volunteers: the cybervolunteers, community leaders that seek, detect and analyse social needs within their local environment and improve it through actions, activities and free training in several digital skills, tools and applications for collectives at risk of social/digital exclusion, fostering at the same time citizen empowerment.
Our main strenght is promote citizen participation, in this way we have developed an innovative platform Empodera.org supported by the United Nations to foster Citizen Participation for SDGs.
Our long path is based on collaboration with other entities and organizations. From our Foundation, we can contribute with our network of 1.500 cybervolunteers who perform direct actions to a network of more than 700 grass roots organisations of different collectives throughout Spain (NGOS, Associations, educational centres, municipalities….). The cybervolunteers generate their own projects, framed by social innovation, from local to global, through the use of new tools to solve old problems in a different way. Cibervoluntarios is pioneer in technological volunteering in Spain.
We help groups of people that may be excluded from information society for their gender, age, professional and/or social environment, lack of time, knowledge, skills, motivation and/or material or economic resources... Our cybervolunteers manage to adapt the use of technological applications to alleviate these social gaps at all levels: work environment, participation, health,. …
All this work has received several recognitions: to“the creation of new forms of participation and social innovation in support of groups at risk of exclusion”, received from the hands of the former Prince and Princess of Asturias in 2011, the economic and social recognition of Google.org, for being one of 50 entities that are changing the world, and the social recognition of the Financial Times as one of “Europe’s 100 digital champions” in 2018. WSIS Prize 2016, In the category “Ethical dimensions of the Information Society”

Foundation goals are:
1. To encourage the adoption and use of ICT by citizens, NGOs and institutions.
2. To promote a responsible and appropriate use of the contents, services, tools and access to Information Society and Knowledge.
3. To promote the creation, training and mobilization of a technological volunteer: the cybervolunteers.
4. To create a social conscience: to generate positive social and cultural attitudes towards the importance of New Technologies for the development and advancement of society.
5. To remove any barriers that prevent knowledge and use of new technologies, especially the physical, social and cultural ones.
6. To encourage participation through ICT and the responsible use of these tools among the youth.

entityDescription:
SeTeL, founded in 1973, operate in the Integrated Logistics Support (ILS). The mission is to provide services, advice, applications and technologies for best level of effectiveness (i.e.: operational availability, risk of support resources shortage, etc.) in the life cycle, of complex systems. SeTeL has carried out activities on more than 120 Complex Systems, in different sectors such as Aeronautics, Space, Naval, Railways, Information/Communication Technology, etc.
SeTeL is a qualified partner of main companies in: 
-Reliability/maintainability/testability studies and Life Cycle Management analysis of complex systems.
-FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCFA, HAZOP, Human Factor Engineering, Safety Analysis
-Training needs analysis and technical training implementation (traditional and multimedia–interactive)
-Technical documentation development (traditional, paper, and electronic-interactive).
-Analytical LCM: operational readiness in the system life cycle cost perspective
-IT Logistics: starting from the Logistics Data Bases, defines methods and processes logistic data to optimize Logistics Support of Complex Systems. MIL-STD- 1388 1A/2B and ASD 3000 L (Logistic Support Analysis DBs) and GEIA-STD-0007 (Product Support Analysis)
-Autonomic Logistics to assess the state of degradation of systems and determine the remaining useful life 
It is an experienced partner in:
-Development of R/D projects.
-Start-up of industrial SME clusters in Aerospace/Defence, collaborating with Universities/Research Centres 
SeTeL Group consists of three companies: 
1. SeTeL: coordinates development, commercial and technical strategies. Provides ILS activities such as R/M, Logistics Support Analysis, Life Cycle Management, Supply support services, Safety Analysis; 
2. SiTiN: develops services and products in Engineering Technical Documentation and Technological Training. In particular: 
-Technical Publication System (TPS) and services (XML, SGML, HTML) compliant with international standards. An -Intelligent Factory- producing: operational-maintenance technical manuals; catalogues; technical and project specifications; documentation for bids, etc..
-Technical training on procedures, techniques and processes applied to complex systems; both traditional training processes and Technology Based Training
-Interactive simulators.
-CBT multimedia courses.
-E-learning systems (SCORM, IACC).
3. DEF-TECH, specialized in R/D solutions. It integrates 47 years of internal expertise on complex systems with the network made with universities and research institutions and has developed several projects in:
-ILS innovation (running).
-New robotic systems (running).
-Damage assessment of composite materials (running).
-Microsensory (running)
-Controls, Monitoring and Measures.
-3D Hybrid microelectronics.
-Stretching Sensors.
-Actuators based on shape memory alloys.
SeTeL is certified ISO 9001 (31 06-2003)
ADOA certification is in place with EASA for the design of avionics equipment.
SeTeL has established a scientific relationship with Rome 3 University on Autonomic Logistic and on ASD3000L and with the Swedish company Systecon on the Analytical LCM.
The capability to afford projects integrating different actors (businesses, universities, research…) characterized by non-homogeneous skills, languages and cultures allows SeTeL to afford successfully projects like the new patented amphibious vehicle.
The company’s average annual investment in R/D activities is 5 percent of total corporate turnover.

entityDescription:
Kinoa is a startup born in Florence in 2016 from the idea of ​​a group of young creatives. The desire was to create a living workshop that develops innovative projects and solutions starting by merging our interpretation of the present, our knowledge of the past and a clear vision of the future.
The products and services offered by Kinoa are the result of a work carried on by a team with multiple and diverse skills, ranging from scientific and IT disciplines to economic and social sciences.
The working method of Kinoa departs from the constant experimentation of the most recent technologies, such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality. These are our raw materials, supplied by qualified partners like IBM and Microsoft. We have learned how to handle such materials and our first creations are a living testimony of that.
For Kinoa, these technologies are only the basis on which we build and shape the finalized solution for our customer. Alongside the developers work, there is in fact the work of those who, after a careful reading of the socio-economic context, are able to tailor the product on customers’ needs.
In our activities, we are supported by research laboratory Data Life Lab, founded by Kinoa together with the University of Florence, the laboratory focuses on the study of young people’s behavior and their relationship with new technologies.
Understanding the transformations of our present is fundamental, for this reason we have created a School of Innovation through which we carry out training and consultancy activities, dissemination through events and publications, and workshop organizationfor young people.

entityDescription:
Machine Learning College is an educational company founded in 2017 with aim to provide an application-focused training and consulting in the field of machine learning and artificial intelligence. We offer a comprehensive and intensive educational program for beginners, as well as various focused trainings for machine learning engineers and data scientists at intermediate or advanced levels. The courses are either public, where anyone with sufficient background can enroll, or private, usually being held at private companies or research institutions. The private courses are often highly customized based on the clients’ preferences.
The topics taught at the courses always reflect the state-of-the-art findings in the field and mostly cover the solutions for the common problems in industry. We aim not only to teach how black-box solutions or libraries can be used, but also to explain the principles of the algorithms inside, which is crucial for being able to design the best machine learning solution for tough problems. Most practical examples are based on open-source solutions.
From 2017 to 2019, Machine Learning College had approximately 400 graduates coming from corporates, startups, universities and government institutions. According to our surveys, most of the graduates are able to independently design and implement machine learning solutions and continue with self-education in the field.

entityName: The Hague Centre for Strategic Studies
entityDescription:
About HCSS
History
The HagueCentre for Strategic Studies (HCSS) was established in 2007 as an independentthink tank. The founder Prof. dr.Rob de Wijk started this organization with a small team ofsenior experts and analysts drawn from organizations such as the Netherlands Organisationfor Applied Scientific Research (TNO), RAND, Clingendael, the Dutch Ministry of Defenseand the United Nations.

Mission Statement
Transforming global challenges of today into solutions for tomorrow.
What we do
HCSS conducts its activities independently and in collaboration with its large network ofaffiliated experts. Our products are diverse:full-fledged reports, issue briefs, quick topicreports, and commentaries in the media. These products often consist of strategic surveys,innovative policy recommendations, trend and scenario analyses, risk assessments,geopolitical and regional security analyses, conflict analyses, operational evaluations andidentifications of lessons learned. HCSS is also a platform for the exchange of ideas anddevelopment of new concepts and strategic insights.
We createmodels and monitorsfor public and private organizations to improve their situational awareness and provide them with a better understanding of their strategic environment. We also compile, collate and generate new datasets, design tailor-made analytical frameworks and build fully interactive web interfaces. Our in-house competencies include predictive modeling using both structural and dynamic data, web scraping, text mining, advanced internet search techniques and data visualization.
Who we work for
HCSS works with clients from both the public and private sectors. We offer our entire rangeof services to both national and international organizations. The Dutch Ministries of Security& Justice, Foreign Affairs, and Defense are among our regular customers. In addition, we alsoprovide analysis to international organizations such as the European Commission and NATO. For private sector customers (commercial and non-commercial organizations andassociations), we translate our strategic orientation to the business environment in order tocontribute to their immediate goals and activities.

entityDescription: Our company started as a spin-off from the University of Bonn. As part of the Menthal project (https://menthal.org), we have been tracking and analyzing smartphone usage data of more than >700.000 participants since 2014 (e.g. time on the phone, top apps, GPS data). With Murmuras we are now also offering our constantly evolving technology to other scientific institutions. Our IT solution allows researchers to independently record the behavior of participants via smartphones and wearables (e.g. time on the phone, app usage, steps per day) and to additionally control intelligent event questions via app (e.g: App notices increased WhatsApp usage during the day and generates a push message: "What's your emotional state?") or even collect the content that they are consuming (chat transcripts, social media interactions, etc.). The data can then be evaluated, analyzed and correlated via a web platform for researchers.

entityDescription: Toscana Life Sciences Foundation (TLS) is a non-profit organization founded by a group of public and private institutions in Tuscany to support research activities in life sciences, in particular, for sustaining the development of projects from basic research to industrial application. It operates in the sector of technology transfer for incubated companies and all regional stakeholders to provide an integrated support for the exploitation of the research system, with particular attention to the protection of intellectual property, business development, and support for the activation of the process of business creation. TLS gathers together all the Tuscany life sciences stakeholders (6 universities, 3 National Research Council Institutes, 4 university hospitals and about 200 companies,) with the purpose of creating, maintaining and keep growing a productive environment in terms of innovation and business opportunity for all players of regional life sciences sector. TLS is part of many networks at Italian and European level. Namely, TLS is part of the APSTI (Italian Scientific Park Association). TLS manages the Tuscany Life Science Cluster (TLSC), thus having access to its entire network of about 200 companies and several research centres, and takes active part in the Italian Life Sciences Cluster. TLS takes also part into the In2LifeSciences project as an Observing Region. TLS is an active member of the National Life Science Cluster of Italy (3 national life sciences industrial associations, 4 national research organizations, 12 life sciences organizations representing regional interests in the sector) and it is also a member of the European Council of Bioregions (CEBR).

entityDescription:
BookingClinic.com is a smart telemedicine and booking platform that connects Patients with Doctors and Clinics around the world, offering virtual medical consultation with your preferred Doctor and online booking engineer to Find, Compare & Book a treatment or an operation at a Clinic worldwide, fostering quality and accessibility in patient’s choice.
 
BookingClinic.com aims to serve the patients who need to consult a doctor and/or have a treatment or an operation. A friendly, trustful online tool to virtually meet a Doctor (via videocall), receive trustworthy medical consultation and finally Find, Compare and Book the best Clinic with the Doctor of choice at the Best Price. Patients have a 24/7 access to transparent info and data on medical experience, hospitality info, customer satisfaction ratings and total costs. Online videocall is offered, upgrading customer’s experience and trust. Clinics can promote their services worldwide, use a new digital channel to attract patients from new markets (medical tourism) and improve their services by receiving crucial feedback from patients. The platform enables them to penetrate the online Health e-market. Insurance companies can also benefit from reduced costs and upgraded customer experience.
National emergency of COVID-19 mobilized the company to offer its services, initially for Greece, for the greater good of all. BookingClinic in cooperation with the humanitarian organisation “Medecins Du Monde” will support the call “#DigitalSolidarityGR” offering telemedicine medical consultation for covid-19 free of charge, in order to connect patients to medical centers, according to EODY protocols. The objective is via a virtual visit to the doctor to be able to consult patients on covid-19 and identify cases that need to be tested or treated for covid-19 so they can be directed to the clinics of the National Health System. This initiative will generate noteworthy traction on the platform and enhance repute thus enabling organic growth and revenue boost.

entityDescription:
ATEM is a French SME which designs and builds tailor-made coax cable assemblies for RF and microwave applications for both aeronautic and military markets. ATEM helps their customers to choose the rightful RF components for their applications. ATEM leads also engineering studies to conceive RF and microwave complex subsystems for embedded systems or RF test benches.
ATEM is based in Toulon and manufactures all the production in our site with a high standard of quality: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, EN 9100 and on-going PART 21 G. We produce more than 60000 coax cable assemblies each year and around dozens RF & microwave subsystems integrations. 
 Our main customers are the defence key players such as Thales, MBDA, SAFRAN, Naval Group and their main electronic subcontractors. We also develop our business in the in-flight entertainment and communication (IFEC) directly for Airbus as a customized connectivity supplier (interconnection kits). We are also a partner for the European Aeronautic Network project. 
For space activities, we are working to get the CNES agreement to embark our products on satellite. We are a supplier of Ariane Group (Ariane 6). We supply space manufacturers with coax cbale assemblies for gorund segments.

entityDescription:
fleXstructures is a young high-tech company located in Kaiserslautern. The company’s main areas of activity are worldwide distribution, services and development of specific software solutions based on new advanced, efficient algorithms. In the domains design optimization, digital mock-up, assembly and path planning for flexible components such as cable harnesses, hoses and all kinds of cables, the company has unique selling propositions with its IPS software products due to precision and computational speed.

Leading national and international OEM, suppliers and service providers of the automotive and heavy-duty industry as well as companies in the aerospace, mechanical engineering and medical technology sectors are customers of fleXstructures. Among others, we are currently active in the departments concept and design, digital mock-up and production planning, pre-production centers – wherever cables and hoses are involved. Further components of the flexstrcutres product portfolio are exemplary our Digital Manikin for ergonomic assembly investigations and the efficient robot optimization tool. A special feature of our different software tools is the good interaction between them. In the mentioned industrial sectors, fleXstructures has gained comprehensive expert know-how and has therefore an excellent reputation. Besides sales and distribution activities, the company renders consulting services, carries out engineering as well as research projects and software trainings. These engineering projects have different aims and purposes: Some of them focus on cable harness design and digital mock-up in development processes in the automotive domain. Other projects deal with cause studies and troubleshooting or aim at achieving a better comprehension of systems and functionality. entityName: Vita- Istituto Tecnico Superiore per le Nuove Tecnologie della Vita
entityDescription:
The “New technologies for Life” Technical Vocational School [Istituto Tecnico Superiore (ITS) “Nuove tecnologie per la Vita” was created to train highly specialized professional figures in a strategic sector of the regional economy, the Life Sciences. The objective of the ITS, which operates throughout the entire Tuscany region, is to fulfill the demand of companies with new high-level technical and technological expertise in a sector that sees Tuscany among the top three Italian regions in terms of the presence of companies and employees as well as turnover.
The “New technologies for Life” ITS Foundation, specifically, is led by the ITIS “Sarrocchi” in Siena and counts 21 partners including the Toscana Life Sciences Foundation (coordinator), the Tuscan Universities of Siena, Pisa and Florence, the provinces of Siena and Pisa, the municipality of Siena, the metropolitan city of Florence, the “Cellini” Institute of Florence, the industrial associations of Florence and southern Tuscany, and the training agencies Toscana Formazione, ASEV, Confindustria Toscana Servizi and Pon-Tech. Several leading companies in the Tuscan chemical, pharmaceutical and biomedical sector are among the companies directly involved in the Foundation and strategic for the training outcomes of the Technical Vocational School: GSK, Menarini, Kedrion, Corima, and Deka Mela.
VITA Foundation manages two-year ministerial courses with a diploma of Higher Technician, 5th level EQF, for the Life Sciences and ICT area, with the following specializations:
· Superior technician for research and development of biotechnology-based products and processes.
· Superior technician for the quality system of biotechnology-based products and processes.
· Superior technician for the production of diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitative equipment and devices.
· Superior technician for methods and technologies for the development of software systems.
Vita Foundation is also accredited to the MIUR for the training of trainers, thus characterizing even more an important role in the transfer of skills and knowledge in the productive field.
Since July 2017 it has been accredited to the Region of Tuscany, according to the provisions of the Council Resolution n.1407/2016 and subsequent amendments, as an accredited and recognized training agency and since August 2018 it has obtained the ISO9001/2015 Quality Certification.
It participates as an affiliate member of the highly specialized Competence Center Advanced Robotics and enabling digital TEchnologies & Systems 4.0 - ARTES 4.0, MISE project.

- Customer Relationship Management
- Environmental Monitoring

- Industrial Automation
- ITSM
- IT Security
- IT Services
- Software Development

entityDescription:
Khymeia is an Italian Company focused on innovative high-end technology medical products and services for rehabilitation (website: www.khymeia.com).
Khymeia has developed the VRRS Virtual Reality Rehabilitation System, an innovative platform for rehabilitation and tele-rehabilitation, based on virtual reality, biofeedback, and exergaming technologies. Originally devised in collaboration with Boston MIT Massachusetts Institute of Technology, the system is now completely developed, produced and marketed by Khymeia. Khymeia also developed the OAK Elderly Care system, a dedicated ecosystem for the evaluation and the treatment of fall risk, and the Neurowave system, an innovative device for the clinical and electrophysiological evaluation and treatment of patients suffering from severe disorders of consciousness (Vegetative and minimally conscious states). Khymeia develops its products in close collaboration with key clinical and research partners and collaborates with the large majority of IRCCSs in Italy. IRCCS stands for Istituto di Ricovero e Cura a Carattere Scientifico) and identifies the Hospitals (both private and public) that manage both clinical as well as research activities; they represent the excellence of the Italian National Health System.
 
The range of rehabilitation applications targeted by the VRRS and OAK methodologies is fairly wide. Originally conceived for neurological rehabilitation in stroke patients, after many years of development and clinical trials VRRS is now a versatile platform that for neurological rehabilitation (upper limb, lower limb, fine hand movements, facial movements, spine tract) in patients suffering from Stroke, Traumatic Brain Injury, Parkinson's Disease, Neglect, Multiple Sclerosis and other neurological conditions, supporting clinical rehabilitation strategies in every stage of the recovery of the patient. VRRS now includes also modules for cognitive, logaoedic, postural, musculoskeletal, sportive, and respiratory rehabilitation. The OAK system, devised for evaluation and treatment of postural stability, is now used as a multidisciplinary tool to support postural rehabilitation for neurological and orthopaedic patients.
 
Khymeia has recently developed a fully functional cloud-based architecture for telerehabilitation, including clinical control stations, devices for patients at home, and web-based applications. Such architecture allows for several services: audiovideconference services, telecontrol services, remote settings of prescriptions of clinically based exercises to be conducted with simple wearable devices, easily adaptable to patient needs and capabilities, and centralized collection of results. The architecture is the backbone of the on-going project “Development and implementation of an Italian Network of Tele-neuro-rehabilitation for continuity of care“ of the Italian Ministry of Health, involving the Italian Neuroscience IRCCS Network. 
 
The VRRS represents the world's most innovative and tested rehabilitation system based on virtual reality technology, whose effectiveness has been accredited by specific international publications on the matter. 
Following 10 years of development and clinical trials, many prestigious international scientific publications have been released. For the full list of relevant publication regarding the usage and the clinical validation of the VRRS Khymeia systems for neuromotor, orthopaedic, cognitive and speech-related rehabilitation, comprehensive of telerehabilitation applications, please refer to: www.khymeia.com/en/validation.

entityName: UNIVERSITY OF MILANO BICOCCA - Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences (DISAT)
entityDescription:
The Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences (DISAT) includes a staff of about 100 people of which about 70 form the scientific permanent staff (professors and researchers) plus 25 units of technical staff supporting research activities in the lab and in the field.
Research activities at the Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences (DISAT) focus on environmental evolution and on the dynamics of planet Earth. Researchers, teachers and technicians belong to diverse disciplines, including geology, chemistry, biology and physics.Our main goals are to:
- study the environment as an interactive system characterized by natural, human and technological components and their mutual relationships;
- analyse with state-of-the-art techniques the composition, history, characteristics and behaviour of a range of materials, to understand the processes controlling the dynamic evolution of the Earth’s surface, on continents and oceans, describing their interactions and impact on climatic change.

Activities taking place at DISAT include scientific research in the frame of international and national projects together with applied research in the frame of contracts with companies and other private and public institutions. Most of our research projects are multidisciplinary and involve complex analyses that require a range of different expertise in disparate fields of the physical sciences
A special lab caled GEMMA develops activities in the field of remote sensing by using and colecting data through different platforms.

entityDescription:
Imagine a world of autonomous Just In Time delivery with no impact on road congestion and no increase in fossil fuel emissions. The kind of delivery that can be carried out by a drone, fast and direct, applicable in any logistical application, from medicine to food, from organs to mobile phones. We have the technology to do this today.
Although organisations, NGOs, charities and companies see great value in using drones for logistics, they don't yet have access. They can go out and buy a drone, but they can't fly it commercially for logistical operations in the UK. For this, not only does the drone need to be understood on a technical level, but it also requires specific systems and regulatory approval to operate within UK airspace commercially and autonomously. We have the solution, and with the support of this funding, it will be robust, simple, and accessible.
Skyfarer's solution is a system of systems, neatly packaged into a robust operational process, leveraging the expertise and technology from our technical partners. It is a platform that allows any organisation to access an ecosystem of drones, to then be used in diverse logistical operations, safely, autonomously and cost effectively with very low capital investment. With this service, we can distribute medication, blood, test kits, food, digital devices and much more within a Just In Time operational framework with very low infrastructure.

entityDescription:
GEONOR AS – Company Profile
Geonor was established in 1957 by NGI (Norwegian Geotechnical Institute) and the Norwegian University of Science and Research (NTNF). The basic idea was that Geonor would be responsible for the production and sale of equipment for geotechnical field and laboratory investigations developed at NGI, which had been established four years earlier. Both NGI and Geonor were established as part of NTNFs longstanding efforts to address the practical and technical problems in rebuilding Norway after World War II.
NGI's first director, Danish-born Laurits Bjerrum (1918-1973), was both the driving force behind the creation of Geonor and its first chairman.He had a great impact on NGI, Geonor and geotechnical research. Since the beginning, Geonor has focused on Bjerrum`s ideas of production and sale of reliable and advanced equipment with high quality. Quality and innovation were key values.
NGI was part owner of Geonor from 1957 to 1997. Norwegian Hydro came in as a partner in 1960 and was the principal shareholder from 1989 to 1997. Øyvind Klevar became managing director in 1993 has been the owner of the company since 1997.
Geonor has been a pioneer in the development of geotechnical field equipment (vane testers and borers, soil sampling), geotechnical drilling rigs, geotechnical laboratory equipment, and in particular geotechnical and meteorological instrumentation based on the vibrating-wire technology. Key partners in this development have been NGI, the Public Roads Administration and the Norwegian Meteorological Institute.
Geonor manufactures and sells geotechnical, hydrological, meteorological and environmental equipment. We deliver quality through cost effective solutions based on our own and third party products. Geonor is certified according to ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015.
Our main customers are government agencies and institutes, consultants, universities and colleges, contractors and other system integrators. 
Our proven solutions are constantly developed by combining the new sensors, wireless communications and Internet-based solutions. We present new solutions for remote monitoring of pore pressure and groundwater level in large ongoing infrastructure projects and based on IoT LoRa WAN technology.
An increasing number of road, rail, infrastructural and natural hazards projects are leading to greater need for site investigations and monitoring of soil conditions and structures. We already deliver a wide range of instrumental solutions for the monitoring of natural forces that threaten society's infrastructure. Climate change and more extreme weather increase the need for automated monitoring and additional measuring points.
Geonor markets and sells its products worldwide and have exported equipment to over 100 countries. The company is the only geotechnical company in the Nordic countries that can show more than 60 years of continuous operations. The company is located in Grini Næringspark in Bærum on the outskirts of Oslo.

entityDescription:
Alis is a service and consultancy company in the areas of occupational safety, industrial hygiene and training. Alis represents the development of a project that has lasted for more than 20 years and which has a wealth of experience under its belt; it operates across the whole Italian territory and in different sectors (trade, health, construction, transport, food, environment, energy) both in the public and private sectors. It brings together qualified professionals with different skills but all offering a cohesive set of integrated and flexible services that act as a solution to support requests made by the customer
Alis is able to offer a wide range of technical consultancy and training services, characterized by some specialized skills relating to the measurement of chemical, physical and biological pollutants in living and working environments, such as chemicals, asbestos noise, vibrations, microclimate, lighting, air quality in general, electromagnetic fields, radon, microbiological contaminants such as legionella, mold and bacterial charges; also it provides management support for the regulatory requirements related to environmental protection, safety and health at the workplace.
At this time of emergency for the Coronavirus pandemic, ALIS with its group companies, is one of the activities considered essential by Presidential Decree on an important research and development in order to oppose the Covid-19.
ALIS is in the front row for the study of the Personal Protective Devices necessary to combat the spread of the virus, it develops technical, organizational and procedural measures for companies that cannot stop production but must guarantee the safety of the workplace; Alis Group companies carry out sanitization and disinfection activities ensuring the result of the intervention by means of a certified test to verify the effectiveness of the reduction of the virological load by means of real time PCR analysis.
The ALIS Group held for over 10 years activities aimed at verifying the quality of air, water and physical contaminants, chemical and biological processes using an experimental methodology: inspection of qualified technicians, context evaluation, sampling, laboratory analysis, processing of results by comparison with legal values and regulatory interpretation.
The experimental and analytical verification of the data through its laboratories is among the distinctive elements of the ALIS group; The ALIS laboratory is recognized by the Ministry of Health and is in possession of the necessary Ministerial authorizations for carrying out specific analyzes on asbestos while the other partner laboratories are in possession of specific sector authorizations (e.g. Accredia certifications).
The quality of the working method, the security of the data, the certainty of the result and the guarantee of the evaluation approach has allowed ALIS to provide services for important companies on the national territory such as: Unicredit SpA – Ambasciata Australiana - RAI - Tubilux, FAO, IFAD, ATAC S.p.A Azienda per la mobilità, Hotel dei Borgognoni - Cassa Forense - Impresa Costruzioni Giuseppe Maltauro – Condotte SpA - ITC Farma di Pomezia - Camera Deputati, OSA Operatori Sanitari Associati, Alstom Ferroviaria, Cassa Depositi e Prestiti - Hotel Cavalieri Hilton di Roma – Plastipak - BNP Paribas - Aeronautica Militare - Guardia di Finanza - Roma Capitale - Ospedale Bambino Gesù - Postemobile SpA - Coni Servizi Spa - Banca D'Italia - EUR SpA - NUCLECO SpA - ISTITUTO LUCE - CINECITTA' S.r.l - TELECOM Italia SpA, Telespazio.
Our offices and laboratories are located in Via Giannetto Valli 93 in Rome. The owner of ALIS srl is dr. Matteo Mazzali.

Harper Adams University was established in 1901 and is a specialist UK agricultural university teaching bachelors, masters and PhDs and conducting strategic and applied research in support of the agricultural and related industries.
The Times Good University Guide ranked Harper Adams as the UK’s Best Modern University in 2020, for thesecond time, and runner-up in the University of the Year category.In the 2019QS World University Rankings for Agriculture and Forestry, Harper Adams University is ranked first in the UK and second in the worldfor Employer Reputation. In the 2019 Complete Uni Guide, Harper Adams Universitywas ranked 17th, up 16 places from 2019. In the most recent UK University research assessment (Research Excellence Framework 2014) 50% of Harper Adams University research was judged to be world-leading or internationally excellent.
The University is organised into five academic departments: Animal Production, Welfare and Veterinary Sciences; Crop and Environment Sciences; Agricultural Engineering; Food Science and Agri-food Supply Chain Management; Land, Farm and Agribusiness Management. The University has c.600 staff including academic staff, and support staff. Academic staff conduct a wide range of research which has a clear focus on meeting the needs of the agri-food and land based industries.Harper Adams currently hosts c.2,500 undergraduate students, c.240 taught postgraduate students, and 63PhD researchers.

entityDescription: GRÜNSTATTGRAU is the Austrian competence centre and central coordination unit for raising issues about the future of urban green environment, innovations and ideas for green cities, for activities targeting research dissemination and knowledge transfer, technical implementation knowledge, participation management and economic and social cooperation concerning Green Infrastructure and nature based solutions on buildings. The aim is to promote all levels of green on buildings through communication, demonstration projects, business incubators, law and policies activities – not only on national, but also on European level. The intention is to upscale and share the results with all partners in the European network and market (knowledge transfer). The instruments of GRÜNSTATTGRAU include a large-scale demonstration testbed, the entirely green implemented neighbourhood in Vienna, a moving Green Laboratory on roadshow and a multi-stakeholder online platform to develop and offer own supporting tools, services and technologies. GRÜNSTATTGRAU operates non-profit-orientated and 100% owned by VfB (Austrian Green Roof and Living Wall Association- NPO led by 12 elected board member experts who support and supervision GRÜNSTATTGRAU with their expertise). GRÜNSTATTGRAU GmbH was founded to coordinate the Austrian Green Living Laboratory “GRÜNSTATTGRAU” – Innovations for Green Cities“ Project initially. The umbrella project, supported by the Austrian Ministry for Climate, Environment, Energy, Transport, Innovation and Technology is set for five years (2017-2022), including over 300 network partners in the fields of economy, R&D and city administration in Austria and several international network supporters, for example the European Federation of Green Roof and Living Wall Associations EFB and its national members. The first level target Area is a densely sealed up neighbourhood in Vienna (Kretaviertel), other synergy areas are for example the cities of Graz, Innsbruck, Klagenfurt, St. Pölten, Linz, Salzburg and Feldkirch. We expect new impulses for the European network for exchange and cooperation with scientific and business partners, public institutions and administration units. The Green Living Lab GRÜNSTATTGRAU represents an innovative approach for facilitation and multiplication of national, European and global interests in Climate Change adaptation/Mitigation through Green Infrastructure and Nature Based Solutions. GRÜNSTATTGRAU is led by two women (Vera Enzi, Landscape Architect and Susanne Formanek, Sustainable Construction Expert) and supported by an interdisciplinary team of employees. The network Partners as well contribute their knowledge and support to GRÜNSTATTGRAU in form of 3 board units (Business, Science, Advisory).

entityDescription:
Sundance Multiprocessor Technology Ltd., was founded in 1989 and has 1000’s of man-years of experience operating as an Electronics Contract Manufacturer (ECM) for Original Equipment Manufactures (OEM) and Commercial-of-the-shelf (COTS) boards with low margins and a high volume of boards for a broad range of customers.
In 2014 we wanted to move more towards becoming an Engineering company with fewer people (2020 = x11 people) and adding more value to each development. The path we took was to get involved in basic R&D with a focus on “Imaging, Vision and Sensors” through the EU funded projects, like Artemis (www.emc2-artemis.eu), H2020 Tulipp (www.tulipp.eu), H2020 VineScout www.vinescout.eu and the Eurostars FieldCompanion (https://www.eurostars-eureka.eu/project/id/11884).
We have recently completed another cascade funded program, ie. an H2020 TetraMax - https://www.tetramax.eu/ - and with our Partners we won a I4MS-SAE Label, see https://www.sundance.com/lynsyn-lite-project-awarded-for-innovation/ 
Sundance has been working with both industry and the academia and therefore has proven (through the success of previous projects) that it is the ideal partner for knowledge transfer. Sundance’s team is composed of multi-disciplinary and high qualified staff that delivers innovative solutions, specially designed, for designing innovative embedded hardware platforms using state-of-art-technologies for accelerating innovative artificial Intelligence algorithms. Sundance’s solutions include highly efficient and low power consumption embedded platforms optimised for running deep learning algorithms used for performing autonomous navigation and for other general computer vision applications. Such solutions are fundamental for the new generation of robotics and autonomous systems.
The focus of Sundance is still Multiprocessing Technology and our keyword technologies/interest are: 
1. Vision System and sub-components for safety
2. Advanced Sensor technology for monitoring 
3. Robotics electronics for control and unmanned vehicles 
4. Deep Learning and Edge-AI 
 
Sundance has in-house manufacturing equipment for electronics board and full test facilities. We run an ISO9001 Quality System to monitor all processes and have done since 1999.

entityDescription:
OUR MISSION
Armatus Oceanic’s continuing mission is to develop and deploy underwater technology to allow the exploration and surveying of up to 11,000 meters below the ocean’s surface.
 
 
WHAT WE DO
- Expert consultancy for high-profile projects.

- Scientific research and surveying of underwater environments.

- Design and development of innovative underwater photography and video hardware.

- Presentations, talks and speaking engagements.

 
 
OUR EXPERTISE
Our team has over 40 years’ combined experience in full depth ocean research as well as the development of technology to allow the exploration of the world’s deepest parts of the ocean. 
We are passionate about continuing to research the deep, as well as bringing those discoveries to the world to promote and educate audiences worldwide about life at the bottom of the ocean. 
To allow us to do this, we have designed autonomous imaging systems for oil and gas companies, cost-effective methods for sampling under oil rigs, and conducted environmental surveys in the field.
We have a relentless track record in publishing our work in peer reviewed scientific journals and making it available to larges audiences quickly. Likewise, our findings and discoveries frequently garner international media attention and global publicity. 
Our team is also passionate about science communication, and regularly delivers public and invited presentations in a style contrary to the sterile conformity of normal scientific outreach, unashamedly relaying our passion and wonder through everything from schools Q&A sessions and art collaborations to stand-up and podcasts.

entityDescription:
Jenny Milne is based in Scotland but enjoys travel and as such has lived overseas and travelled around the globe and her energy and enthusiasm often earns her the reputation of being a ‘pocket rocket’. This description sums up well her enthusiasm and passion for social policy and transport. Very much an ‘out of the box’ thinker, Jenny is strategic and visionary and is well known for facilitating innovation and delivering on projects.

For those interested in the transport industry, having spent nearly 20years in the ITS and technology field, Jenny is currently involved in a number of projects, but one of growing interest to many is based upon the rural economy in Scotland. This originated from her first hand experiences from the last decade having a cottage in Boat of Garten which is based in the Cairngorms National Park. The area consists of 5 local authorities, 3 RTPs, several transport providers for bus, rail, community transport, taxi, cycle hire etc as well as community and business organisations. Until 2016 there was no joint partnership/board working towards a solution fit for visitors and residents alike. The challenges range from no 3G/GPRS, mountains and a fractured transport network. Jenny has brought together all the stakeholders from the ground level (community/businesses) to the top (Government organisations) together with the vision and determination to deliver Mobility as a Service. Given what’s already been said about the ‘pocket rocket’, it will be of no surprise to learn that Jenny took on a part time PhD in 2018 on Rural Mobility as a Service (R-MaaS) and in 2019 secured Innovate UK funding for Cairngorms Connected.Jenny was also involved in a project led byConnected Places Catapult in Aberdeenshire on understanding the need and demand for rural mobility services. Finally, Jenny is the founder of the Scottish Rural Islands and Transport Convention which has run since 2018 and focuses very much on mobility, economic growth and sustainability in rural areas both in the UK and overseas.

entityDescription:
Black Arrow Space Technologies Ltd was founded in 2017 to bring together the existing and highly-renowned Formula-1 and space technology sectors in the UK, to provide a developer of space-ready structural hardware, notably propellant tanks, and a novel operator of cost-effective satellite launch services. The technology design and development centre will be based in Southern England, close to the Formula 1 and space industry centres, while the test stands and spaceport-related operations will be based in South Wales, thereby bringing a major space entity and associated jobs to the Enterprise Zone in Port Talbot.
The initial intent is to produce space-ready tanks for integration into the Black Arrow launchers, placing 500 kg payloads into Polar or Sun Synchronous orbits. The Company will also attract products from many innovative SME's from around Europe and act as an attractive flight bed for new technologies.
The primary USP of Black Arrow will be the adoption of a seaborne spaceport: two vessels that will comprise the launch fleet, with a launch location off the South West of Ireland. The seaborne operation provides many advantages over the traditional land-based spaceports, notably: low-cost and low-impact establishment of the spaceport; low-risk to the public, property and critical infrastructure due to avoidance of land overflight, disruption of air corridors, and overflight of populated areas; low-emissions by utilising readily available cryogenic propellants, in the propulsion of vessels and vehicles. From this location, trajectories can be supported to North or South. After demonstration of the small launch system is complete, the same design approach will be used to scale-up the launch vehicles and the fleet to provide a larger lift capacity and allow the fleet to offer a launch service around the world, for friendly nations who would otherwise not be able to provide local launch services to be able to do so. This offering will be a very popular offering in various places and disrupt the established land-based market for small launchers.

Professional project management for international projects of a high level of complexity is one of the many key competencies the akquinet group offers their clients. Crypta Labs is a London-based quantum security company with the ambition to build futureproof hardware to provide secure communications for connected IoT devices everywhere.

Crypta Labs has designed a Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG) with real world applications in mind. Every cryptographic task requires a source of random numbers, which means weak randomness equals weak cryptography. Our QRNG has passed all the randomness tests from NIST and TestU01 suites, unlike some of the competitors on the market today.

We have also developed a Hardware Security Module (HSM), designed for use in connected autonomous vehicles (CAV). The HSM can perform a range of cryptographic tasks including key generation and management and will be an EU mandated requirement within both the vehicle and infrastructure as C-ITS is adopted. The HSM was designed in accordance with the European Commissions’ Security Policy and is currently used in the Czech Republic’s participation in the CRoads pilot scheme. 

We are currently integrating our QRNG technology into the HSM, using its quantum random numbers to seed cryptographic operations. The QHSM will provide reliable cryptographic support seeded by high-quality random numbers at a local level.

We have also developed a Hardware Security Module (HSM), designed for use in connected autonomous vehicles (CAV). The HSM can perform a range of cryptographic tasks including key generation and management and will be an EU mandated requirement within both the vehicle and infrastructure as C-ITS is adopted. The HSM was designed in accordance with the European Commissions’ Security Policy and is currently used in the Czech Republic’s participation in the CRoads pilot scheme. 

We are currently integrating our QRNG technology into the HSM, using its quantum random numbers to seed cryptographic operations. The QHSM will provide reliable cryptographic support seeded by high-quality random numbers at a local level.

entityDescription: Spegea was founded in 1981 by the Industrialists' Association of the Province of Bari. Spegea has been offering for almost forty years a wide range of post-graduate and post-diploma training proposals addressed to young people, giving them the opportunity to acquire their own managerial style, with problem solving abilities, which are typical characteristics of those who decide to undertake a career in Business. Every year the school organizes MASTER’S & COURSES of Specialization intended for young graduates and High school graduates on themes of great relevance, structured around a time-honored formula which involves the alternation of classroom activities with a period of internship. SPEGEA’s experience, gained in the field of education, has permitted us to develop a specific methodology aimed at supporting companies in the design and implementation of training programs for their employees and managers, enabling them to guarantee true innovation in the management of production processes.The school organizes tailor-made training courses on different areas of basic management and on issues of great topical interest: Planning and Control Systems, Communications, Organization and Human Resources management, Information systems.Doing "good training" for Spegea means producing concrete results and carrying out continuous exchanges with the business world. Since 1991 the school has been an ordinary member of ASFOR - Association for training in business management. Since 2008 Spegea has been majority owned by Exprivia spa, an international group specialized in Information and Communication Technology able to direct the drivers of business change of its customers thanks to digital technologies. The business school is still today also participated by Confindustria Ba-Bat, a trade association that offers important contacts with companies in the entire region, both with a view to developing needs analysis for specific sectors and for carrying out activities training courses aimed directly at employees of the same companies, both for the search for internship opportunities and placements for course participants.In 2011 Spegea participated as founding member in the establishment of the Antonio Cuccovillo Technical Institute for Mechanics and Mechatronics, a foundation that pursues the aims of promoting and disseminating technical and scientific culture by offering specialized training courses in response to training needs expressed by the Apulian mechatronics companies. Spegea is part of the Apulian Information Technology Production District, an Industrial District recognized by the Puglia Region, as a community made up of businesses, consortia, universities, employers' associations and trade unions active in the Apulian information technology sector. To ensure achievement of its objectives, SPEGEA has adopted a System of Quality Management, with reference to the activity of “design & provision of Management training, funded or self-financed, for both public & private entities”, in compliance with UNI EN ISO 9001:2015.
