entityName: Gutierrez Melendez, Alba Rebeca - Dynamics Genesis
entityDescription:
Climate change is a defining issue of our time, and we are at a critical moment of irreversible damage to our planet. From changing weather patterns that threaten food production to rising sea levels that increase the risk of catastrophic floods, the impacts of climate change are global in scope and on an unprecedented scale. Without stronger action today to mitigate global warming, it will be more difficult and expensive to adapt to its inevitable future impacts.
City air is a sorry state. It is dirty and hot. Outdoor pollution kills 4.2 million people a year, according to World Health Organization and the problem is likely to get worse. Now, 55% of the people live in cities and 2050 that share is expected to reach 68%, so far cities are responsible for 70% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Greenhouse gas “GHG” emission is a serious problem and has negative impacts on the urban quality life, population´s health (large amounts of public spending related to health and well-being derived from pollutants), agriculture and water. City governments are important agents of action due to their close relationships with local businesses and citizens. All key collaborators together must take increasingly strict measures of prevention and solve these problems. Currently, there is not so much understanding and transparency of the real impact of Greenhouse emission from natural and human activities due to a lack of appropriate system and methodologies that help governments and institutions to identify assess, track, and provide accurate diagnostics of air, and therefore, provide the most appropriate corrective measurements. 
Under this context, Dynamic Genesis offer an innovative monitoring system of measurement, that relies on unique algorithm named AxSat that process data from Copernicus Sentinel 5P and identify average of CH4, NO2, SO2, O3 concentration and provides information about Greenhouse gas emission to urban domain to the society in general, through a methodology that consist of monitoring (AxSat maps), Report (AxSat analytics), Verification (AxSat GHG Inventory) and Implementation (decarbonization strategies and some come cases Carbon market strategies). Benefits of our product and service are:
a) Estimate of the amount and type of GHG emission to obtain more transparent, accurate and comparable reporting of air quality diagnostics, that mean develop more cost and time effective strategies of reduction and mitigation of carbon.
b) Support subnational government entities such as cities and states that represent large GHG source regions e.g. megacities with actionable information on their GHG emission to evaluate and guide progress towards emissions reduction goals.
c) Provide Information to industry and private sectors businesses that will help locate and quantify previously unknown emission reduction opportunities.
d) Provide information to GHG inventory builders in support of their efforts to reduce uncertainty of national inventory report to UNFCCC.
e) Support the Paris Agreement global stock take as government and UNFCCC.

Software Engineering and Dev-Ops

Systems – Engineering
The success of complex technology projects depends heavily on efficient systems engineering. With years of experience in system engineering, we support you as a competent and reliable partner in this process.
Systems engineering is for the most part the ongoing process of coordinating requirements, goals and framework conditions between clients, users and developers in order to capture all the requirements of a complex project. In addition to the technical aspects, the focus is also on the legal framework and approval criteria for the area of ​​application. During the entire process, the comprehensive documentation on all sections of the system development for successful quality assurance must not be neglected.
We help you to your success by setting up traceable, tool-based systems engineering processes and reliable quality assurance measures

Processes, Tools & Methods
Due to many years of experience in system and software development and the associated processes and methods, we are able to provide you with competent support in the implementation of your project in all project phases. When developing your system, we take advantage of our extensive expertise in all areas of avionics, automotive and railway transportation.
For the development of professional software and hardware, suitable and highly integrated development tools are required that optimally support the selected software development process and make it manageable, also with regard to the fulfillment of a specified development standard or process model. This includes tools for project management, the management of requirements, risks, tasks, tests and errors that are essential for complex system development. 

Verification & validation
Testing is an elementary component within a development project. Ensuring the required quality of software and hardware while respecting time and budget is crucial. Especially for safety critical systems, effective and efficient testing is mandatory.
We offer our customers the complete portfolio: starting for an individual test strategy and test planning, test management up to the test execution of integration and module tests and reporting and problem tracking.

We ensure reproducibility of releases, traceability and clarity on versions of allcomponents that we included to a build of our products. Systems – Engineering
The success of complex technology projects depends heavily on efficient systems engineering. With years of experience in system engineering, we support you as a competent and reliable partner in this process.
Systems engineering is for the most part the ongoing process of coordinating requirements, goals and framework conditions between clients, users and developers in order to capture all the requirements of a complex project. In addition to the technical aspects, the focus is also on the legal framework and approval criteria for the area of ​​application. During the entire process, the comprehensive documentation on all sections of the system development for successful quality assurance must not be neglected.
We help you to your success by setting up traceable, tool-based systems engineering processes and reliable quality assurance measures

Processes, Tools & Methods
Due to many years of experience in system and software development and the associated processes and methods, we are able to provide you with competent support in the implementation of your project in all project phases. When developing your system, we take advantage of our extensive expertise in all areas of avionics, automotive and railway transportation.
For the development of professional software and hardware, suitable and highly integrated development tools are required that optimally support the selected software development process and make it manageable, also with regard to the fulfillment of a specified development standard or process model. This includes tools for project management, the management of requirements, risks, tasks, tests and errors that are essential for complex system development. 

Verification & validation
Testing is an elementary component within a development project. Ensuring the required quality of software and hardware while respecting time and budget is crucial. Especially for safety critical systems, effective and efficient testing is mandatory.
We offer our customers the complete portfolio: starting for an individual test strategy and test planning, test management up to the test execution of integration and module tests and reporting and problem tracking.

Technopôle Brest-Iroise: an association

The Technopôle Brest-Iroise, formed as an association under the 1901 law, brings together all of the region's economic players around a genuine economic approach: companies, grandes écoles, universities, research centers, communities, professional bodies, etc.

Created in 1988, the Technopôle Brest-Iroise mobilizes energies to facilitate each stage of the development of an innovative project, with a clear objective: to promote their economic growth and the creation of wealth in the region.

Our vocation

The vocation of the Technopôle Brest-Iroise for 30 years has been to support entrepreneurs who wish to develop their activity through innovation. Leading collective actions, promoting complementarities between partners, strengthening links between research players and the business world in the service of regional development through innovation.

Innovation at the heart of our actions.

Created in 1988 at the initiative of local authorities, economic and scientific players, the Technopôle Brest-Iroise is supported by Brest Métropole and the Brittany Region in order to contribute to the development of innovation and employment in northern Finistère .

Our ambition: Develop, enhance and support the competitiveness of the territory through innovation

3 missions.

ENTREPRENEURSHIP: Support the creation and development of innovative businesses in the region

FEDERATE: Develop partnerships, strengthen expertise

ANIMATE: Network, pool resources, promote expertise for the benefit of the territory and its stakeholders

entityDescription:
Avaintec Oy, founded in 1997, is a company that offers AI-as-a-Service solutions and AI-related consulting services. Avaintec’s offices, which are located in Ruoholahti in Helsinki and in China in the cities of Hangzhou and Chengdu, host a multinational team of experts. Thanks to the commitment of both staff and management Avaintec’s products have achieved a stable market share in the public sector and health care in Finland. Avaintec is owned by its management and employees. The company is financially sound and has grown strongly and viably within recent years. Company rating on 16.1.2020 is AAA based on financial statements without personal credit information. Avaintec’s values are quality, integrity and respect.
Avaintec has international quality and information security certifications ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 as well as ISO 13 485 health care quality certification. The certifications cover all the company’s operations and products and they have been valid for over 10 years.
The company has been a forerunner in digital archives and digital signature product development and offering. In September 2019 the company sold its archive and signature business units to Visma Consulting Oy. Through its archive business the company developed a strong know-how for cleaning and molding different data masses and data structures as well as utilizing the clean and molded data in different purposes in health care and in the public sector. This line of business has created a very strong basis for starting the development of artificial intelligence and machine learning business operations in 2015.
After the trade with Visma Consulting the company has focused on the development of AI and ML based solutions for the public sector, especially for social and health care organisations. The focus of Avaintec’s business is on offering and developing AI-as-a-Service solutions and consulting services.
Avaintec’s solutions’ functionality has been aimed to be as easy to use as possible and to match client needs. The developed AI solutions have been designed to improve the client organisations’ operational efficiency, data processing and decision making. Avaintec aims to create simple solutions from complicated data to produce valuable knowledge to support operations and improve the everyday life of customers. Avaintec develops solutions in close collaboration with clients and the user friendliness of the solutions is guaranteed by service design.
Avaintec has several on-going AI and ML development and implementation projects with Finnish and Chinese social and health care organisations. At the moment some of Avaintec’s development partners include South Karelia social and health care district, The Hospital District of South Ostrobothnia, Helsinki University Hospital, Lapland Hospital District and Peoples Provincial Hospital in Chengdu China as well as Zhejiang Children's Hospital in Hangzhoussa China. In addition Avaintec works in cooperation with LUT University, Åbo Akademi and Hangzhou University.

neurocat is a Berlin start-up with a focus on AI quality. neurocat has been offering comprehensive and cutting edge AI analyses and improvements for almost 3 years now. Together with a specially formed industrial consortium, neurocat has played a leading role in the development of the world's first technical standards (DIN SPEC 92001, Parts 1 and 2) for describing AI quality parameters and is also leading the German delegation to the international ISO/IEC committee on artificial intelligence (IEC/IEC JTC1/SC42).
In addition to software-supported services in the areas of research, consulting, analysis, troubleshooting, and improvement of AI modules and data, neurocat offers an analysis tool (aidkit) that is unique in the world to date. With the help of this tool, AI developers and users can test the quality (robustness, comprehensibility, performance) and improve it subsequently. 
neurocat works cross-sectorally with international industrial companies that are currently piloting safety-critical AI systems. In addition, neurocat is currently working with national federal authorities and conformity assessment bodies to develop an initial concept for the certification of AI systems.

We offer producers, contractors, architects, owners and branch organizations, governments and private parties a wide range of services. You can rely on us for:
▪ Material testing of environmental, mechanical, durability, optical and other properties on either raw materials or (semi) finished products using internationally accepted standards or tailor-made methods

Geo Space Analytical Services (GeoSAS)
Geo Space Analytical Services (GeoSAS) was originally established by Dr Menghestab Haile (a British Citizen of Ethiopian Origin) and registered in London in October 2012. The main objective of the company is to provide high quality consultancy services to meet the growing demand for evidence and knowledge-based decision making needs in Africa through the creation of effective partnership with the private sector in the UK and Europe. Anchored on this strategic objective GeoSAS’s vision and mission include:
Vision:
- People: the first point of call for inspiring Africa by creating innovative opportunities to drive human development and seizing the momentum of Africa’s renaissance.
- Portfolio: leaders inknowledge and technology-based services provision that support governments, communities, business enterprises and individuals achieve their developmental aspirations.
- Partners:drivers who nurture platforms for a network of service providers and beneficiaries to jointly create mutually enduring value for society.
- Productivity:a highly effective, lean and fast-moving organization.
 
Mission 
Human Capital
Providing support to public and private education and training provider institutions in policy review, design,implementation and development, including appropriate tools for:TVET systems; distance education, health systems, apprenticeship system, raising skills and employ-ability, e-learning facilities and ICT, mentoring, fostering innovation through imparting in-depth skills, and support private enterprises and public organizations increase workers’ skills to enhance enterprises’ competitive advantage and improve efficiency and effectiveness of public services. 
Natural Resource Management
Introducing climate smart agriculture and effective use of agricultural inputs to increase sustainable production and closing the yield gap by building capacity of farmers through the strengthening of agricultural research centres, public and private agricultural advisory services, farmers’ training centres, and strengthening farmers’ organizations.
Evidence-based information systems
Provide public and private policy decision makers and processes with evidence-based information and analysis and tools in various developmental policy areas, including:climate change adaptation and mitigation strategies, risk and impact analysis, early warning systems, employment creation strategy development, poverty reduction and community resilience building strategies, validation and dissemination of best practices, and promoting inclusive development focusing on women, the unemployed and underemployed youth.
Catalyzing investment in productive sectors
Brokering investment financing partnerships by serving as hub of information on regional and country business opportunities for potential investors, facilitate and assist preparation of feasibility studies and consultancy services for major infrastructure projects, represent and engage with interested international companies to look after their interests, prepare business feasibility studies for potential and prospective profitable business; and supporting governments develop investor friendly and effective regulatory frameworks, including fiscal and financial incentives as appropriate.

Ergonovix inc. is an Ergonomics, Human Factors and Industrial Design consultation firm.
Ergonovix specialises in Virtual Ergonomics with the use of a Digital Human Model (DHM) software from the Dassault Systemes company.

Jeanne Guérin, Principal ergonomist at Ergonovix has extensive years of experience in the fields of space and aerospace at major international firms such as Bombardier Aerospace, Boeing, Blue Origin and Bureau Veritas.
She owns a Bachelor degree in Industrial Design , A Master in the field of Human Factors in a microgravity environnement and a certified Professional Ergonomist designation.
She is also a certified trainer by the Ministry of Work in Québec and a Private pilot with an instrument rating.

Ergonovix is an advanced ergonomics firm offering services in Advanced Ergonomics Design, Virtual Ergonomics, Human Factors Engineering and Industrial Design for the Space and Aerospace sectors.

When a Human is involved an Ergonomist must be involved as well to avoid human errors and risks of injuries.

entityDescription: GTechnology Foundation is a non-profit Scientific Research Organization as defined in the European Commission Communication 2006/C 323/01 of 30/12/2006.GTechnology Research Organization has the purpose of carrying out basic research activities, industrial research, experimental development, execution of tests, generic tests, compliance and compatibility tests on its own, on behalf of European SMEs and on behalf of third parties. Company description: The aim of Science Centre AHHAA is to introduce science to everyone and encourage studying through the joy of discovery. SA Tallinna Tehnika- ja Teaduskeskus (the Tallinn Technology and Science Centre Foundation) is the official entity of the science centre Energy Discover Centre.
The Centre’s mission as an informal learning environment is to motivate and advance the teaching and learning of STEM subjects. In order to achieve this, the Centre has over a hundred hands-on exhibits, which allow visitors to discover and learn about physical phenomena, and a number of workshops, science shows, and other activities for children starting from kindergarten up to secondary school level (16–17-year-old students). The Centre’s educational programme is closely connected to the national school curricula.
The Centre, being housed in a former power plant first opened in 1913, has mainly focused on the complex topics of energy production and consumption, but also classic natural phenomena – light, optics, and sound. The Centre’s Planetarium programme introduces the Solar System, and technological advances in space. Workshops and temporary exhibitions also address natural phenomena and climate changes.

entityDescription: iSeaMC GmbH provides the people, expertise, equipment and technologythat support cost efficient robotic seafloor monitoring surveys. Our services include pre-installation-surveys, baseline studies including biodiversity assessment, habitat mapping and the control of seafloor installations. Our monitoring solutions are a cost efficient part of the mandatory impact assessment strategies throughout the entire life-cycle of your operations. iSeaMC offers sea floor robot technology, called crawlers. iSeaMCs founders have more than 10 years of experience in producing and deploying these benthic crawlers on various installations. The current crawler “Rossia” is the result of a joint collaboration between space- and deep sea sciences. The analogies between space and deep sea motivated the German Helmholtz Association to setup the joint research program ROBEX (RoBotic Exploration under EXtreme conditions). ROBEX consisted of a consortium of German maritime and space research institutions and conpanies (including DLR, AIRBUS), where space and underwater scientists and engineers cooperated to find solutions to similar challenges and to mutually benefit from each other's technologies and capabilities. The project outcome was the improvement of an already existing crawler, which had been in tele-operation in the deep sea for 12-18 months deployments since 2010.

entityDescription:
About Medizinische Universitaet Wien (MUW) or Medical University of Vienna 
The MUW is not only the largest medical organisation in Austria, it is also one of the most important top-level research institutions in Europe and provides Europe's largest hospital, the AKH in Vienna, with all of its medical staff.
With its long history and tradition, which covers 650 years (independent since 01.01.2004), MUW has developed into a highly modern research institution. About 5,700 staff members work in 26 university hospital departments, 2 clinical institutes and 12 centres of medical science. 660,000 patients receive the highest quality treatment from MUW and Vienna General Hospital each year, with 110,000 of them admitted as inpatients. The university’s 8,000 students secure the future of medical treatment.

Triple track strategy
In its structuring and alignment Medical University of Vienna relies on the triple track strategy. Research, education and patient care represent the three cornerstones of the university's system. This enables medical science to respond flexibly to the continually changing demands of the state and society. In the process, maintenance of health as well as therapy, abatement of symptoms and prevention of diseases stand in the foreground.
International competition in relation to medical research and the development of innovative solutions to issues relevant to society such as healthcare or age pyramids are among MUW’s core tasks. Also the disciplines of ethics, medical law, care related research, palliative medicine and health economics are of central importance.

Medical training / Career
MUW is Austria's largest medical training centre and intends to become a leading healthcare player in the future. In the process, extraordinary support measures for highly talented researchers as well as performance related career models for doctors alongside participation in international networks and extra-university cooperation ventures will play a central role.

5 Research Clusters
Inter-disciplinarity and Translational Research are key-words for MUW. Practically all of our organisational units are involved in medical science and medical diagnostic related research.
a. Medical Imaging Cluster (MIC)
b. Allergology/Immunology/Infectiology Cluster (AIIC)
c. Cancer Research/Oncology
d. Medical Neuroscience Cluster (MNC)
e. Cardiovascular Cluster (CVC)
MUW works on innovative research concepts for national and international researchers with the objective of establishing an international competence centre in the spirit of a centre of excellence.

Patient care
The innovative translational research approach is an integral element of MUW’s development plan; as a result of this, considerable opportunities are available to its patients. Through the unique inter-linking of fundamental research with clinical applications, patients benefit directly from the results of clinical studies. A further plus for patients is implementation of the interdisciplinary approach in the core-area: research. Cooperation of all of the doctors concerned with treatment and a bundling of the medical skills represent a decisive factor for success, particularly in relation to the care of cancer patients.

Academic private partnerships
In order to secure additional sources of funding for future research activities, MUW intends to support patenting and the commercial utilisation of research results (the so-called academic private partnership) and has even set up its own service organisation for this purpose.

c. Cancer Research/Oncology
d. Medical Neuroscience Cluster (MNC)
e. Cardiovascular Cluster (CVC)
MUW works on innovative research concepts for national and international researchers with the objective of establishing an international competence centre in the spirit of a centre of excellence.

Patient care
The innovative translational research approach is an integral element of MUW’s development plan; as a result of this, considerable opportunities are available to its patients. Through the unique inter-linking of fundamental research with clinical applications, patients benefit directly from the results of clinical studies. A further plus for patients is implementation of the interdisciplinary approach in the core-area: research. Cooperation of all of the doctors concerned with treatment and a bundling of the medical skills represent a decisive factor for success, particularly in relation to the care of cancer patients.

Academic private partnerships
In order to secure additional sources of funding for future research activities, MUW intends to support patenting and the commercial utilisation of research results (the so-called academic private partnership) and has even set up its own service organisation for this purpose.

entityDescription:
PLUX was created in 2007 with the ambition of helping the world access human biosignals to improve solutions for health, research and, overall, simplify human-computer interaction scenarios. During its journey PLUX has been able to collaborate in innovative research in a growing number of science fields that use biosignals as key data to improve human health, performance or to expand the frontiers of knowledge. PLUX creates innovative products for Healthcare and Research, by developing advanced biosignal monitoring platforms that integrate wearable body sensors such as electromyography, electrocardiography, respiration, accelerometers, and others, combined with wireless connectivity and software applications to deliver real value recognized by our target markets. PLUX has a significant track record in the creation of innovative added-value products, examples of which include the work on novel technologies for physical rehabilitation (http://www.physioplux.com). An advanced wireless toolkit designed for researchers to collect and analyze reliable, high definition Biosignals data, Biosignalsplux. The latest success case is a DYI product, BITalino, (https://bitalino.com/en/), which in little over five years gathered more than 4000 users, base scattered across more than 30 countries worldwide.
Our mission as company is to create miniaturized sensors and wearable devices for biosignal acquisition and processing. All products aim to provide users with maximum comfort and safety, together with user-friendly software. Given the strong partnerships established with other scientific institutions, PLUX sets the bridge between the academic field and the market, by applying and projecting the research know-ow to problems and practical needs, in several technological areas.
From high know-how on analog-digital filtering and amplification electronics, PLUX can provide the acquired signals with very low noise, high sensitivity and high immunity to electronic interferences. Currently we have a set of biomedical sensors such as, Functional near-infrared spectroscopy sensor (fNIRS), Electroencephalography (EEG), Electrocardiography (ECG), Electromyography (EMG), Electrodermal Activity (EDA), respiration, accelerometer and others, from which several physiological parameters can be extracted, such as: heart rate (HR), heart rate variability (HRV), muscle activation (EMG), sympathetic events from EDA sensors or energy expenditure from an accelerometer. Beyond biomedical sensors, PLUX also has expertise in hardware development, enabling the quick turnaround and discovery of new solutions, new applications, third-party sensors integration and market-focused strategies in the field of biosignal sensing.

entityDescription: Zama is a Paris-based startup building open-source software tools that enable developers to eas-ily deploy secure deep learning applications powered with homomorphic encryption. Zama aims to propel deep learning into a revolutionary new era of privacy-preserving cognition by providing developers with cloud-based and on-premises homomorphic machine learning solutions. Their solutions currently focus on inference rather than training, and are designed for simplicity. Users upload their trained neural networks, which Zama converts into encrypted equivalents with their homomorphic compiler and loads into a runtime environment that distributes processing across a cluster of CPUs, GPUs, and ASICs to enable real-time inference; users can then send encrypted inputs and receive encrypted outputs using a secure API. The complexity of cryptographic optimization is abstracted away from users of Zama’s service, which enables a streamlined migration from existing unencrypted products to end-to-end encrypted equivalents.

The Public Safety Communication Europe Forum (PSCE) is a permanent autonomous organisation based in Brussels aiming at improving provision of public safety services and the safety of the citizens during crisis and emergency situations. PSCE provides a common platform for researchers, industry and users to meet and network, learn about technologies used for public safety and influence policy makers at European level. 
 
PSCE is regularly consulting its membership to understand users’ needs, identify gaps in current solutions and define appropriate requirements. This deep understanding is also used to evaluate innovative solutions and assess their potential benefits for practitioners.
Our constituency also validates the solutions or concepts developed in the framework of various EU funded projects. The association has a proven track record in market analysis, exploitation and business plans. 
PSCE is also engaged in standardization activities and is a full member of ETSI and 3GPP. PSCE has been also co-chair of multiple CEN Workshop Agreements. 
As a forum, PSCE is an expert in provision of enhanced and well-elaborated communication. PSCE organises number of workshops, webinars as well as two major conferences. It publishes regularly information to its members (Quarterly Newsletters, Flash news).

Archetipo is an innovative company specialized in development and provision of engineering services in the sectors energy, infrastructure, agriculture and archeology.
It has a dedicated data analysis center for the return of processed at different resolutions depending on the areas to be detected, from the single building to extended territorial sectors, finalized to the realization of DEM and DTM and three-dimensional models for BIM design and urban planning.
Thanks to the experience and expertise in the field of use of professional drones, equipped with a wide range of sensors (LIDAR, thermographic and multispectral), plays a diversified air monitoring activities dedicated to the inspection of areas urban and large territorial areas: from the photogrammetry of high precision, to the evaluation of the instabilities, to the analysis of physical parameters of the earth's surface.
Archetipo provides remote sensing services for precision farming. It uses high-resolution images from both satellites and UAV systems for mapping extremely detailed of the vegetative state of crops. The very high resolution images acquired through low-altitude flights are reworked by specific software which extrapolate synthetic vegetative indices linked to the vigor of the crop; thematic maps in digital format are produced from the multispectral data, representing the variability of the vegetative vigor of the crop (biomass, chlorophyll rate, leaf density). From these, the prescription maps are obtained which can be loaded on VRT automated operating machines equipped with integrated GPS that assign a different treatment quantity (fertilizer, fertilizer, water) according to the specific vigor zones. This process, programmable easily and in a very short time, allows savings in the use of agronomic products and guarantees a considerable reduction in costs.Its customers are municipality, Autostrate per Italia, Terna, the firs grid operator for elecicity transmission in Europe and others smes

entityDescription:
GARI is a independent Prague based research organization that uses advanced technologies (big data, AI, ML, natural language processing, sentiment analysis) to map globalization through both global flows (big data) as well as mapping institutional social and political frameworks - an unprecedented endeavour enabling us to empower decision-making and obtain and control a profound understanding of the globalised world.
​In cooperation with the Czech Institute of Informatics, Robotics and Cybernetics, the Global Arena Research Institute (GARI) came up with a revolutionary way of researching the nature, impact and management of globalizing socioeconomic, political, environmental, and security trends.

Technological progress isincreasingly outperforming the development of our normative, institutional and political capabilities.

As a result, governments and institutions are often unable to provide the answers people seek. Theinternational environment has become one ofconstantinstability,feeding into unprecedentedfragilityandunpredictabilityon global, regional, and domestic levels. It should come as no surprise thatgeneral distrustandalienationis growing within societies.
​
Rapidly developing processes and structural changes on aglobal scale are contributingtoincreasing vulnerability within democratic, open, and market-oriented states.

At the same time, the global arena is becoming ever less intelligible.Among the chief reasons is the fact that researchers attempt to understand complex global processes with only a fraction of the available data.Under these conditions, confusion and anxiety have already translated into disruptive social and political behaviour in the form of rising populism anddistrust.
​
Social sciences and technological advances must inform and influence each other.This conjunction mustbe natural, serving the future of humanity ona global scale. The mission of the Global Arena Research Institute is no less than that.
WE ARE TRYING TO MAKE CONCEPTUAL, NORMATIVE, ECONOMIC, ANDPOLITICAL DECISIONS WHILE, IN FACT, WE POSSESS INSUFFICIENT KNOWLEDGE ABOUT THE ENVIRONMENT IN WHICH WE ARE MAKINGTHESE DECISIONS.
The well-being of states with open governmental systems is dependent on and derived from therule-based, multilateral international orderthat emerged after World War II. Yetthe continuation of this order has beenincreasingly challengedat its normative core.
​
The world of academia has struggled to provide solutions. Traditional ways of studying international politicsfail to deliver results,as the velocity ofchanges leavesthe world of experts unable to keep pace. The phenomena that shape global changes largely fall outside the boundaries ofestablished concepts of thinking.
​
Why?

The process of globalisation has significantly increased volumes of flows(people, commodities, energy, technologies, finance, data etc.) across nations, regions and the globe, thus creating a global arena that defies traditional way sof analyzing international relations. Shifting patterns of interactions create conditions for the emergence of newactorsandpower-centres.In this fluid and fast-developing environment, it is becomingdoubtfulwhether governments andinternational organizations– in their present forms – possess the necessary leverage tosecure theirroles in society.

entityDescription:
The IMDEA Materials Institute, one of the seven Madrid Institutes for Advanced Studies (IMDEA), is a public research centre founded in 2007 by Madrid’s regional government. The goal of the Institute is to do research at the forefront of Material Science and Engineering, attracting talent from all around the globe, and collaborating with companies in an effort to transfer fundamental and applied knowledge into valuable technology.

The Institute is organised into sixteen research groups, each of them participating in one or more broad research programmes. Being a medium size centre, researchers are encouraged to collaborate with other top research groups, leading to an open, collaborative environment, also drawing international scholars.

As a result of its growth, over 150 people do research at the Institute, including more than 45 post-doctoral scientists and 60 pre-doctoral students. The state-of-the-art experimental and computational facilities enable the groups to do research at the forefront of Material Science and Engineering, currently publishing above 120 JCR journal articles per year.

Our continued effort to collaborate with companies has led us to sign more than 70 industrial projects. In them, we work with companies all over the world, helping to address their more complex technical challenges, transforming our know-how into better products, and tackling some of the most pressing problems in Material Science and Engineering.

In parallel, personnel that has left the Institute are now working in companies and universities inside and outside Spain, helping to improve society through a better understanding and usage of materials.

The goal of the Institute is to do research at the forefront of Material Science and Engineering, attracting talent from all around the globe, and collaborating with companies in an effort to transfer fundamental and applied knowledge into valuable technology.

The Institute is organised into sixteen research groups, each of them participating in one or more broad research programmes. Being a medium size centre, researchers are encouraged to collaborate with other top research groups, leading to an open, collaborative environment, also drawing international scholars.

As a result of its growth, over 150 people do research at the Institute, including more than 45 post-doctoral scientists and 60 pre-doctoral students. The state-of-the-art experimental and computational facilities enable the groups to do research at the forefront of Material Science and Engineering, currently publishing above 120 JCR journal articles per year.

Our continued effort to collaborate with companies has led us to sign more than 70 industrial projects. In them, we work with companies all over the world, helping to address their more complex technical challenges, transforming our know-how into better products, and tackling some of the most pressing problems in Material Science and Engineering.

In parallel, personnel that has left the Institute are now working in companies and universities inside and outside Spain, helping to improve society through a better understanding and usage of materials.

entityDescription:
IRT Jules Verne, set up in 2012 as part of the Investissement d’Avenir (Future Investment) programme, is a mutualized industrial research centre dedicated to advanced manufacturing technologies. Its vocation is to improve the competitiveness of strategic industrial sectors in France by creating disruptive technologies for manufacturing processes. Its mission is to speed up innovation and technology transfer to factories.

IRT Jules Verne offers 5 areas of technological expertise: Robotics and Cobotics | Composite Materials Processes | Metallic Materials and Additive Processes | Modelling and Simulation | Characterisation, Monitoring and Control.
The IRT team works hand in hand with the very best industrial and academic resources in the manufacturing field.
Together, they strive to develop innovative technologies that will be deployed in the short to medium term in 5 research areas: Forming and Preforming Processes | Assembly and Joining Technologies | Additive Manufacturing Processes | Mobility in the Industrial Environment | Manufacturing Flexibility.
Working closely with production equipment manufacturers and integrators, IRT Jules Verne caters to 4 strategic industrial sectors: aeronautics, shipbuilding, the automotive industry, and renewable marine energy.
In its bid to provide comprehensive solutions up to scale-1 demonstrators, IRT Jules Verne installs and utilises a wide range of exclusive state-of-the-art equipment.
As well as this core business, IRT Jules Verne also tackles additional challenges:
- Promotion of industrial professions in response to the needs of businesses,
- Deployment of a coordinated strategy with the EMC2 Competitiveness Cluster in relation to the French ecosystem dedicated to open innovation in manufacturing.

entityDescription:
An estimated 8 million tons of plastic waste enter the world’s oceans each year (UNEP). Marine pollution causes biodiversity loss and hampers ecosystem functions and services. Plastics progressively degrade into micro plastics. Pesticides and other toxins adhere to these micro plastics which can be accidentally ingested by small aquatic life. Once ingested, the toxins bio magnify as they move up the food chain, accumulating in ocean products consumed by humans. 
The cost of damages caused by plastic waste discharged into the oceans is estimated at:
- $ 13 billion each year by the UNEP on a world wide scale.
- $ 82 Million of loss per annum for the European fishing sector.
Dealing with Floating Lethal Plastics (FLP: Floating Plastics which have escaped the trash management chain to the environment) has to be a part of the necessary multi-layer solution which should be activated to solve the plastic pollution problem. 
In this context, FLP detection tools are compulsory to analyse the time and space varying distribution of FLP.
-On the long time scale, decisions makers require these data to set up action plans to manage plastic pollution.
-On the short time scale, operational pollution remediation actors need such data to optimise their efforts.
Taking advantage of the growing citizen’s mobilisation against plastic pollution, I Clean My Sea (ICMS) aims to develop two FLP detection tools based on a crowd-sourcing scheme:
-A crowd-sourcing Progressive Web Application (PWA) to detect floating plastics on a world wide scale. Any person seeing floating trash can simply shoot a picture of it with the PWA. The person detecting the FLP is further named a “Sentinel”. The picture and its satellite-derived location are stored in a database.
-An algorithm for the identification of floating debris accumulation areas from satellite produced data (Visible and/or multispectral and/or radar). The development of this algorithm will use the ICMS PWA database as ground truth data source.
Taking advantage of the existing Floating Debris (FD) collection market (at least 12 boats collecting FD in France), ICMS deploys specialised boats to collect FLP (Further called “Collectors”). 
Onboard the Collectors, the dedicated interface of our PWA will give the mariners the following information:
-The position, timestamp and picture of the FLP detected by the Sentinels.
-The drift forecast of the FLP to ease the collection process after detection.
Operating Collectors brings guarantees to the Sentinels that their volunteer use of our application will lead to real pollution remediation action. 
The unmatched collecting efficiency of our Collectors will be our best argument to sell subscriptions of the collector interface of our PWA to pollution remediation actors throughout the world. In addition to the financial resources provided by the FD collection market, the Collectors will be used as communication medium for sponsors to co-finance the developments and exploitation of the ICMS PWA.

The person detecting the FLP is further named a “Sentinel”. The picture and its satellite-derived location are stored in a database.
-An algorithm for the identification of floating debris accumulation areas from satellite produced data (Visible and/or multispectral and/or radar). The development of this algorithm will use the ICMS PWA database as ground truth data source.
Taking advantage of the existing Floating Debris (FD) collection market (at least 12 boats collecting FD in France), ICMS deploys specialised boats to collect FLP (Further called “Collectors”). 
Onboard the Collectors, the dedicated interface of our PWA will give the mariners the following information:
-The position, timestamp and picture of the FLP detected by the Sentinels.
-The drift forecast of the FLP to ease the collection process after detection.
Operating Collectors brings guarantees to the Sentinels that their volunteer use of our application will lead to real pollution remediation action. 
The unmatched collecting efficiency of our Collectors will be our best argument to sell subscriptions of the collector interface of our PWA to pollution remediation actors throughout the world. In addition to the financial resources provided by the FD collection market, the Collectors will be used as communication medium for sponsors to co-finance the developments and exploitation of the ICMS PWA.

We enable the full value of connectivity by creating game-changing technology and services that are easy to use, adopt, and scale, making our customers successful in a fully connected world.

Networks 
We develop, deliver and manage telecommunication networks by providing hardware, software, and services to enable the full value of connectivity. From 5G and IoT to virtualization, we are supporting digital transformation for the next generation of mobile services.

Digital Services

We help service providers to embrace this change with network management and operations (OSS), revenue and customer management (BSS), communication services, core network and network functions virtualization (NFV), infrastructure, and application development and maintenance (ADM).

Managed Services

By managing and optimizing telecom networks and IT operations with highly industrialized processes and a truly global delivery model, we enhance operators' ability to meet – and exceed - consumer expectations.

We accelerate new and sustainable businesses beyond Ericsson's traditional core business. Technologies like 5G, artificial intelligence, automation, VR/AR, and edge computing are opening up new, vast opportunities for our customers, partners and our company. entityDescription:
The Centre of Excellence Unmanned is dedicated in provision of COTS and services on UAV and robots. Its software EZ CHAINS is a Command and Control software that enables swarm of UAV to carry out complex mission. EZ Chains controlling the fleet of drones can also be used for Surveillance purposes, proposing significant performance enhancements, such as:
- Exploration by UAV
- Supervision
- Security and Inspection
- Cartography & Defect inspection
This software is embedded in each light UAV (<40 KG). Each unmanned system can navigate without remote control. The different drones are cooperative and have an organized mission order to create a swarm of drones. Each drone has the full mission plan, and each drone communicates with the others (4 times/ second). If a drone is out of order, another drone can replace it automatically. The software manages a safe dropping with a camera and embedded Artificial Intelligence. It is independent from hardware after a calibration phase. Tests have been performed with a payload until 9 Kg per drone, total weight of the drone being 35 Kg. Autonomy: 30 Minutes. 
SCALIAN can provide VTOL, manufactured through a China-free Supply Chain.

entityDescription: Da quando nel 1992 si è costituita, la ESSEBI opera prevalentemente nel settore dei servizi per l’ingegneria strutturale. Sua specifica competenza è l’implementazione di impianti di monitoraggio statico o dinamico, sia di strutture civili che di opere architettoniche, nonché lo svolgimento di attività di diagnostica generale, su manufatti in calcestruzzo armato e precompresso, acciaio, muratura e legno con prove e strumentazione dedicata a carattere prevalentemente non distruttivo. Precedenti esperienze in vari campi dell’ingegneria dei soci fondatori e soprattutto le loro variegate professionalità, spazianti dall’elettronica alle costruzioni civili, senza disdegnare il vasto settore delle misure meccaniche, le hanno consentito in poco tempo di occupare una posizione di preminenza in un mercato in via di consolidamento, in grado di fornire ampio spazio ad aziende flessibili e ben strutturate dal punto di vista operativo. A partire da una consolidata esperienza derivante da oltre venticinque anni di ininterrotta attività, la ESSEBI fornisce oggi un valido supporto a tutti i vari operatori del settore (liberi professionisti, società di costruzioni, sovrintendenze, pubbliche amministrazioni, amministrazioni di condominio, ecc.) che, trovandosi al cospetto di manufatti, recenti o antichi, di cui poco si conosce o che versano in uno stato di ammaloramento evidente o presunto, necessitano una diagnosi relativa alla qualità dei materiali, alla tipologia e organizzazione costruttiva, al quadro evolutivo dei dissesti esistenti o degli effetti conseguenti ai fenomeni vibratori insorti negli anni, a seguito della costante ed inevitabile evoluzione delle città, ed invecchiamento del costruito. Tale esigenza non si pone più solo per il nostro patrimonio di carattere storico e monumentale, ma sempre più frequentemente laddove s’intenda, responsabilmente e preventivamente, procedere alla sicurezza, alla difesa ed al recupero del patrimonio edilizio ed infrastrutturale esistente. In particolare gli ultimi sviluppi nell’ambito della identificazione e caratterizzazione modale delle strutture hanno consentito di dotarla di strumenti per una efficace diagnosi basata sul periodico controllo di parametri dinamici e per analisi sperimentali di vulnerabilità, di fondamentale importanza in un territorio come quello italiano in cui il rischio sismico è decisamente elevato.

entityDescription: Arcam EBM AB is a GE Additive company that develops and manufactures Additive Manufacturing systems for production of complex metal components directly from three-dimensional designs. The Additive Manufacturing process Electron Beam Meling (EBM), also known as Electron Beam- Powder Bed Fusion (EB-PBF) was originally invented by the founders of the company back in 1997. The first commercial system was delivered in 2003 and since then more than 400 systems have been installed worldwide. The company's patent portfolio consists of more than 200 patents/patent applications belonging to 56 different registered patent families of the Electron Beam Melting technology. Arcam EBM is today the world leader in offering systems for Electron Beam – Powder Bed Fusion process.In the Arcam Electron Beam Melting process fully dense metal components are built up, layer-by-layer of metal powder, melted by a powerful electron beam. Electron Beam Melting makes it possible to manufacture metal components with optimal properties in small and medium volumes. Orthopedic implant manufacturers utilize the technology’s potential in cost-effective manufacturing of products with advanced functionality and increasingly the aerospace industry has been building up knowledge, resources and expertise in readiness to use EBM manufacture.Arcam EBM was acquired by General Electric in December 2017 and is now a part of the GE Additive company ecosystem. Arcam EBM as an entity has more than 240 employees in Mölnycke, Sweden. Here, development and production of the EBM systems is conducted. The company today offers five different Electron Beam Melting platforms for various industry segments capable of producing various metallic materials. Apart from the EBM systems, Arcam does also offer surrounding equipment, materials, services and training for customers to facilitate full industrial production.

R&D activities pursue different goals, namely, to advance data management systems incorporating low-cost, widely available mobile computing technologies, and to integrate territorial monitoring systems and tools in support of land use planning. entityDescription:
KALOMA SA was founded in 1998. It was then licensed for 150 tons of production (sea bream, sea bass, etc.). The unit is located in the Sagiada Strip, in the northern part of Thesprotia in a sea area of ​​15 acres (1.5 hectares). From October 2018 in SKALOMA the position of "Ormos Orlias" with an area of ​​15 acres was annexed.
The current production amounts to 590 tons per year - TSIPOURA - LAVRAKI - KRANIOS - MYTAKI - FAGRI. It is certified with HACCP and ISO. It standardizes and packs its fish in a also certified packaging plant while most of the production is exported to Italy, Spain, England, USA and Canada.
Research interests
SKALOMA SA implemented the SEA-On-A-Chip research project, funded by the HORIZON program. The object of the project was to create an integrated sensor that operates automatically and has the ability to perform biochemical analyzes in the marine environment, detecting potential biochemical contaminants that could threaten aquaculture, sending wireless data and alerts. The project was successfully completed in May 2017. The unit carried out the experimental application of the integrated sensor.
Today he implements the research project SEAFOODTOMORROW (HORIZON 2020). The object of the project is to enrich the fish through their food with ingredients that will enhance their nutritional characteristics. The project started in November 2017 and has a duration of 36 months.
It also implements, in collaboration with the University of Ioannina, the ENVIAQUAMAN project, within the framework of the Epirus Regional Development Plan. The object of the project is the real time control of physicochemical parameters with the aim of protecting the environment and the certification of Pisces.
Implements in collaboration with ELKETHE, the AQUA -IoT project, an innovative application of smart IoT networks in the interconnection and transfer of environmental data and industrial applications for integrated coastal zone management at POA level "in the Fisheries Operational Program" 2014-2020 ".
Finally, the implementation of the PROGNOSIS project - "Correlation of Abiotic and Biotic Factors for the Development of a Disease Prognosis Model in Fish Farms", funded by the European Fisheries and Maritime Fund in the 2014 Operational Program 2020 ", in collaboration with ELGO - DIMITRA.

Starting with 2018, MDX Research has shared its interest in immunization through media channels and its social media pages LinkedIn and Facebook and had several targeted activities concerning the uptake of vaccines. In June 2020, we partnered with University of Szeged, Hungary and Catalyst Scientific from Vienna, Austria to develop the project EQUAL-V, with the scope of integrating sociocultural diversity to mitigate vaccine inequality. The project focused on addressing low vaccine uptake in EU Member States and was advanced under Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation Grant Programme.
Our drive is to bring a real change and a long-lasting impact in healthcare access, medical research and organizational health literacy. Stronger health literacy and health literacy responsiveness drive forward equity in health outcomes by making health care accessible to all citizens.

Kuipers Electronic Engineering BV was founded more than 40 years ago and is a family owned company with two main activities: TMX Smart Telecontrol and YES-Partner. These two main activities stem from a philosophy and passion to offer the best possible solutions for our clients technically as well as economically. All disciplines needed to achieve this can be found under one roof. Hard- and software development, production, testing, R&D, hosting services, consultancy, project management, sales & marketing and 24/7 support are all represented in our own organisation. Westrongly believe in the added value of having all these disciplines resulting in an end user focused approach and high standards when it comes to product quality en reliability.
Since we combine all these disciplines we can quickly respond to technology changes and customer demand. Having close connections with for example Delft University of Technology, TNO and being member of the Hague Security Delta (HSD) we’re in close contact with the latest developments and trends.
Under the brandname TMX Smart Telecontrol all activities concerning tele monitoring and tele control take place. TMX Smart Telecontrol has its own main station either web based (TMX-Net PRO) or on premise, its own substations (intelligent PLC’s) such as the LMX400 and LMX800-series. Anticipating on the latest development concerning communication technology such as NB IoT, LTE-M and LoRa, TMX developed an IoT platform called IMX. This IoT platform allows end users to implement an economically priced device which connects with a wide variety of sensors. With the use of the IMX, end users can implement large scale sensor grids which allows for data driven usage.

entityName: EURAC RESEARCH - Institute for Renewable Energy (RenEne)
entityDescription:
The INSTITUTE FOR RENEWABLE ENERGY conducts applied research on ADVANCED ENERGY SYSTEMS, based on or including SUSTAINABLE ENERGY SOURCES.

Its activities include NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL RESEARCH PROJECTS, as well as direct COOPERATION WITH INDUSTRY PARTNERS. Industry-related projects normally involve the development of new products and the evaluation of technological solutions. The Institute also supports the promotion of renewable energy technologies and assists political decision-makers the scientific consultancy.​​
The Institute's research involves the extensive use of DYNAMICSIMULATIONS and MULTIPHYSICS MODELLING of advanced energy systems and buildings.​​ Scientific results are based on LABORATORYTESTS of single components and integrated energy systems, as well as the MONITORING of applied demonstration sites, experimental outdoor installations and residential buildings. The Institute offers support also in the elaboration of COMPLEX ENERGY MODELS as DECISION SUPPORT SYSTEM for single energy systems or buildings as well as for urban and regional areas.

The Institute is structured into FIVE RESEARCH GROUPS:
SUSTAINABLE HEATING AND COOLING SYSTEMS​​ focusing on hybrid and efficient heating and cooling systems for buildings, industry and sustainable districts
PHOTOVOLTAIC ENERGY SYSTEMS​ focusing on the analysis of solar resources, performance and reliability of PV modules and systems and their integration into buildings and electricity grids
ENERGY EFFICIENT BUILDINGS​ focusing on energy flexible buildings, façade systems concepts, solutions for natural ventilation and daylighting, cost optimal solution-sets for NZEB with high IEQ​​
ENERGY RETROFIT OF HISTORIC BUILDINGS​​​ focusing on energy performance of historic buildings and districts, conservation aspects in retrofit solutions and energy planning​
URBAN AND REGIONAL ENERGY SYSTEMS​​​ focusing on sustainable energy planning, decision support system, ​big data frameworks, economic and financial evaluations of energy solutions​​

entityDescription:
Modern light weight construction can only happen if it is based on a reliable structural integrity. The current challenge is the validation of the component quality. Applied Validation of NDT is specialized in state-of-the-art evaluations for nondestructive testing methods. E.g. POD, ROC, and technical FMEAs based on modern concepts of multiparametric influences, complex relationships between complex defect structures and modern testing equipment. 
AV-NDT promote the probabilistic and structured evaluation of NDT systems due to a variety of projects together with industrial partners from energy sector, railway or automotive and due to scientific publications.

AV-NDT owns a large database on reliability evaluations of different methods, materials and testing systems. Furthermore, they have the access of a variety of different statistical software programs capable of calculating different kind of reliability results even for more complex multiparametric evaluations with sparse data. 
Dr. Daniel Kanzler is working for more than ten years in the field of reliability evaluation of non-destructive testing systems. He started his career at GE Sensing and Inspection Technologies in the field of ultrasonic testing with his diploma and his master thesis. Later he changed his job to the Federal Institute of Material Testing and Research, Berlin, into the department Radiology, where he finished his PhD 2016. Different publications, his diploma, master and PhD thesis considered different perspective of testing systems for the field of ultrasonic testing, radiographic testing, visual testing and eddy current testing. The probabilistic evaluation due to realistic defects with multiparametric influence analyses and the inclusion of economical KPIs was one of the accomplished goals. 
He has the NDT Master degree with certified three level 3 in ultrasonic, radiographic and eddy current testing (ISO 9712). Since 2012 he is lecturer of DGZfP (German Society of Non-destructive Testing), for different universities (e.g. at TU Munich and TH Aschaffenburg) and tutor for the European American Workshop on reliability of NDT. 
Since 2017 he is leading the ICNDT specialist group on NDT Reliability. Furthermore, he is reviewer on different international standards and scientific papers.

Founded 1999, HOLOEYE Photonics AG is providing products and services in the fields of diffractive optics (DOE), spatial light modulators (SLM) and LCOS microdisplay components. HOLOEYE´s development and engineering team is based in Berlin together with technical sales.
HOLOEYE offers a great variety of microdisplay based Spatial Light Modulators products for phase and/or amplitude modulation. Based on both translucent or reflective liquid crystal microdisplays, HOLOEYE’s SLMs have been utilized in numerous applications ranging over holographic projection and security systems via optical metrology, optical switching devices, biophotonics, laser pulse shaping, and even laser material processing. 
HOLOEYE developed and characterized a number of phase modulator products for high resolution holographic applications for the visible, near-infrared and telecommunication waveband. 

The LCOS microdisplay division is providing manufacturers in the field of technical optics, specifically technical projection, imaging, and display technologies, with LCOS microdisplay-hardware other Liquid Crystal micro displays and electronics design services as component solutions. 
HOLOEYE is specialized in the development of custom drive electronics, flex cables and display packages and also offers custom LC designs and display customizations for specific applications which have demands beyond standard projection displays. 
HOLOEYE is also providing customized design, fabrication and replication services of Diffractive Optical Elements. Besides that HOLOEYE also offers a broad range of standard Diffractive Optical Elements with various patterns like dot arrays, dot-circles, circles, multi-lines and cross patterns.

entityDescription:
Industry Disruptors Game Changers (IDGC) is an independent non-profit organization established with the vision to create an extrovert ecosystem that fosters innovative entrepreneurship on a global scale. We deliver this through initiatives that empower mission driven innovators to create scalable companies & bring them in effective partnership with investors, industry leaders & key stakeholders creating an impactful ecosystem.Since 2012 IDGC have achieved organic growth to over 64 countries across 5 continents.
The mission: Industry Disruptors Game Changers were created with the mission to break down barriers for entrepreneurs that will become industry disruptors and game changers with global reach. We deliver this through a competitive process that brings together entrepreneurs, investors, industry leaders, and key stakeholders.
The actions:
IDGC were born in 2012 in an effort to assist the Greek youth in a time of severe crisis and youth unemployment rates reaching sky-high at 60%. Since its formation, IDGC quickly became one of the leading organizations in Greece awarding more than 3.5 million euros in cash, work & skill enhancement opportunities, scholarships and services to young talented innovators.

Among various activations in Greece, IDGC operates an international tech idea-stage accelerator program (Founder Institute Athens), an ICT incubator (Invent), actually the first PPP of its kind in Greece – in collaboration with the National Technical University of Athens, Digital Policy, Telecommunication and Information Ministry and the Greek Mobile Operations Association. IDGC also run 6 global talent discovery competitions (taking on a sectoral approach), and numerous other initiatives.We work closely with governments (Sweden, Holland, Cyprus, Denmark, US), as well as, academia (11 universities around the world and plus new synergies on the way) and support big corporations on how to promote innovation and enhance entrepreneurial mindset.

In short, Industry Disruptors Game Changers have
▪ Designed and administered a comprehensive portfolio of more than 200 cross-cutting events promoting innovative entrepreneurial ideas▪ Raised more than $3.5 million in cash, work & skill enhancement opportunities and services that were awarded to disruptive entrepreneurial ideas and ventures
▪ Established effective partnerships for more than 600 entrepreneurs and startups by bringing together talent, knowledge, mentoring, education, funding and networking
▪ Designed and lead, Disrupt Startup Scaleup, the first & biggest innovation event in Greece
▪ Designed and developed Future Agro Challenge, a global platform on innovation in the primary sector, that has achieved global presence in 64 countries

entityDescription: ITA was established in 1934 as part of the Faculty for Mechanical Engineering of RWTH Aachen University. At present, we employ more than 40 research staff, 35 service personnel and over 125 student research assistants. The Institut für Textiltechnik belongs to the Faculty for Mechanical Engineering of RWTH Aachen University. The focus of our research is therefore on the development of new textile machines and new textile processes. We do not do research in textile design or finishing or clothing technology. The current areas of research are Spinning, spinning preparation, nonwovens Textile fabrics production (weaving, knitting/warp knitting, braiding) Man-made fibre technology Technical textiles and fibre-reinforced composites Medical textiles and biomaterials Smart Textiles Textile economics Quality management and process optimisation Recycling We carry out research within publicly funded projects (e.g. EU) and also in direct R&D projects for industry.

IOR is one of the tradition companies in Romania, having a great experience in the field of designing and producing opto-electronic and opto-mechanical products. 
IOR was established in 1936 under the Romanian Optical Industry name. 
In 1941, the company was militarized, manufacturing especially products for the army (binoculars, sights, a.s.o.) 
In 1948, IOR became a national firm . 
From 1960, IOR is registered as Trade Mark at WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization). 
During the eighties, new fields has been approached, such as: opto- electronic, laser, metrology . 
After 1989, we have developed the concerns for qualitative improvements of the products and services. 
At present, IOR has implemented a quality management system according with ISO 9001 and AQAP 2110.

Put simply, we aim to disrupt conventional value chains and transform all businesses into social enterprises. By promoting inclusive business models that create shared value and pay for the true costs of doing business today, we believe we can truly shift the balance of value chains.
Because the fact is, businesses today with social enterprise ambitions do not have a lot of options. For these companies, FairChain is a proven value chain shifter. We have a strong track record of the promoting this new economic mindset. Put bluntly, action above words.
With no vested interests, we have been as critical of our own actions as we have been critical of the actions of others. This is because we believe it takes radically open and transparent communication to discover new insights. While we are critical, we are also inclusive. Everyone is invited to join our movement.

Our vision
We believe that the supply chain is the new frontier in responsibility, an almost entirely unexplored area rich with opportunity. Our goal is to create impact consortia that see the value that can be found in healthcare, reducing poverty and climate impact, deforestation and sustainable economic developments. Cross-sectoral partnerships (Impact consortia) should become the preferred mechanism for delivering sustainable development. This opens the door to NGO-private sector partnerships that link corporations’ triple bottom line reporting with NGOs’ more business-like approach of to achieving joint impact goals.

entityDescription:
3D Research was established in 2008 as a spin-off company of the University of Calabria. It is specialized in the development of digital and engineering solutions in the field of Cultural Heritage. In particular, over the years the company has gained considerable experience in the field of CGI, Virtual and Augmented Reality, ICT, computer vision and marine robotic, applied to the management and promotion of both terrestrial and underwater cultural and naturalistic assets. 3D Research currently offers services and products for art galleries, museums, and other public and private organizations by developing interactive VR and AR exhibits, virtual museums, mobile apps, serious games, and digital storytelling to encourage visitors’ engagement. 
In recent years 3D Research has focused part of its research and business activities in the Blue Economy sector by providing innovative solutions for the sustainable tourism valorization of the underwater cultural and naturalistic heritage. In detail, the "virtualization" of underwater cultural and naturalistic sites obtained using optical and acoustic 3D imaging techniques and computer graphics technologies are mixed with other cultural and creative contents (text, audio, video, animations) in order to create VR/AR systems designed to enhance the visitors’ experience both in-situ (i.e. helping divers during the exploration of an underwater archaeological site or tourists visiting a museum) and ex-situ, to promote CH destinations and revitalize tourism attractions.

entityDescription:
ISEP is a French engineering graduate school in digital technology, known as a “Grande École d’Ingénieurs”. ISEP trains very high-level graduate engineers who receive a thorough training in Electronics, Telecommunications & Networks, Software Engineering, Signal-Image Processing and Humanities, providing them with the required knowledge and skills to meet the needs of businesses. 
The research at ISEP is organized within a single laboratory LISITE (Laboratory of Computer Science, Signal and Image, Electronics and Telecommunication) placed under the authority of the Director of Research, Mr Carlos Bader and which is composed of specialized research teams that can interact in multidisciplinary projects.

The LISITE includes about fifty researchers: 25 professors, Six of them hold an habilitation to direct the research (HDR), more than twenty PhDstudents and post-docs.
The LISITE Laboratory is an associate member of the EDITE doctoral school in Paris: doctoral school in Computer Science, Telecommunications and Electronics at the Sorbonne University.

The main research areas of the laboratory are: Artificial Intelligence / Resource Management in Multi-User Wireless Systems / Advanced Image Processing and Coding Methods / Energy Hervesting Systems / Micro, Nano and Electronic Systems.

Research at ISEP finds its applications in several areas:
- Health and Medical Image processing
- Connected environments: Internet of Things, sensor networks, autonomous vehicles, LiFi, 5G, etc.
- Environment 
- Education and enhancing human learning

entityDescription:
Cintel Global is a multi-disciplinary creative production house and end to end content studio. We work within the fields of Immersive Technology, Interior Design, Video and Animation and in order to create marketing materials and experiences for brands.

We are a skill-diverse team of Artists, Designers, Storytellers, Animators, Filmmakers, 3D Modellers and Immersive Experts. We have a deep understanding of immersive production pipelines and are one of the few studios in the North East working with integrating cutting edge Motion Capture and Photogrammetry into our bespoke production pipelines.

We are based in Proto: The Emerging Tech centre in Gateshead. The first digital production facility of its kind in Europe and one of the biggest R&D Centres for emerging technology. PROTO is also part of the Digital Catapult NETV network, and is also home to the North East Tees Valley Immersive Lab (one of only four in the UK). This means that we have access to the latest production techniques and hardware surrounding the worlds most cutting edge tech. We have been developing a range of immersive projects and experiences for the past year and a half. We are the only company trained and authorised in the usage of both the motion capture & photogrammetry rigs at Proto. We utilise multiple production methods (360 capture, 3D modelling and Photogrammetry) to create immersive experiences for a range of formats and Devices. We have developed internal production processes that allow us to photographically recreate real-world environments in 3D through a process known as ‘photogrammetry’. Through a utilisation of the above methods we are able recreate life like environments and experiences. 

Our 2 Directors have a total of 15 years experience in the creative industries. This Year one of our directors has undertaken a PHD in the recreation of history through immersive technology, utilising motion capture and photogrammetry.

entityDescription: Tidal Flyer Ltd. is a SME Tidal Energy Device Developer. The system being developed is Tidal Flyer and is a Tidal Energy Converter (TEC) using tidal streams to drive a loop of vertical underwater hydrofoils, supported on cables top and bottom, and spanning part way or fully across a channel. The Tidal Flyer concept belongs to the family of vertical axis turbines that extract energy from the tides in a similar manner to horizontal axis devices, except that the turbine is mounted vertically. The tidal stream causes the foils to transverse the flow thereby rounding 4 No. vertical axes to complete one full rotation; power is generated on both upstream and downstream lines with 2 No. Power Take-Off units per system. The concept has the very large swept area which is expandable and scalable which in turn provides a high efficiency for a tidal device of approximately 44%. The hydrofoils capture tidal stream energy and convert this to mechanical movement.

entityDescription:
Antea Poland is a leader in providing advanced engineering and consulting services. It belongs to the global ANTEA Group.
Antea Group is an international engineering and environmental consulting firm specializing in full-service solutions in the fields ofenergy, environment,infrastructure,urban planning, andwater. By combining strategic thinking, multidisciplinary perspectives and technical expertise, we do more than effectively solve client challenges we deliver sustainable results for a better future. With more than 3.200 employees in90 offices around the world, we serve clients ranging from global energy companies and manufacturers to national governments and local municipalities.
Antea Poland with its more than 25 years of experience on the domestic and international market provides engineering and consulting services in the field of energy, gas, industry and infrastructure. The specialist knowledge of our experts and innovative solutions guarantee the highest quality of services provided to the private and public sector. 
The company was established in 1992 under the name of CITEC S.A., then it was transformed into Tractebel Engineering S.A. In May 2019 it became a part of the Antea Group, changing its name to Antea Polska S.A. Thanks to the employment of high-class professionals, the company quickly gained a leading position in the water and sewage services market, while taking a place in the leading Polish engineering companies in this branch.
For the needs of the market, in 2006 the company started intensive development of its activity in the energy sector, which allowed it to build a strong position as a provider of engineering and consulting services in the field of conventional energy, transmission and distribution of electricity, and renewable energy. For several years Antea Polska has also been one of the main suppliers of services in the design of high pressure pipelines, gas facilities and LNG systems, thus contributing to the improvement of the country's energy security. Since its inception, Antea Polska has played a strategic role in supporting both public and private sector customers and its success is due to the emphasis on innovative solutions that contribute to the implementation of effective solutions.
Scope of works:
A wide range of activities, apart from energy and gas, also includes services for industry and infrastructure, hydrotechnics and waste management.
Drawing on the experience of an international team of consultants and engineers, Antea Polska offers full project management at every stage of project implementation, from concept and feasibility studies, through the preparation of complete tender and design documentation, to Contract Engineer service, construction management and technical consulting, as well as afull range of other engineering services according to the requirements of the project and the needs of the clients.
