entityName: TECHNISCHE UNIVERSITAT DRESDEN - Environmental Remote Sensing
entityDescription: The Junior Professorship in Environmental Remote Sensing was established in September 2019 and was designed as the future successor of the Chair of Remote Sensing at TU Dresden. The group (JProf. Matthias Forkel) conducts research on the application and development of satellite data sets and derived products to observe, analyse, model and predict changes in vegetation and the related impacts on the carbon and water cycle, and on vegetation fires. Thereby a focus is on the use of microwave satellite instruments such as passive microwave radiometers and radars (Sentinel-1) to characterise changes in vegetation moisture content, phenology and productivity. The group has profound experiences in the use and development of time series analysis methods, machine learning, global fire-enabled dynamic global vegetation models, and model-data integration techniques.

entityName: Mediterranean Information Office for Environment, Culture and Sustainable Development
entityDescription: MIO-ECSDE is a non-profit Federation of 130 Mediterranean NGOs working in the fields of Environment and Development in 25 countries of the Euro-Mediterranean area. MIO-ECSDE acts as a technical and political platform for the intervention of NGOs in the Euro-Mediterranean scene on nature and biodiversity, resources and waste, health and environment, climate change, cultural diversity as well as on horizontal and cross-cutting issues. MIO-ECSDE is certified for meeting ISO 9001:2015 standards in the design, development, management and implementation of international and European projects on environment and sustainable development and it is committed to a high standard of transparency, accountability and effectiveness and is a signatory of the Accountable Now. MIO-ECSDE’s highest decision-making body is the Annual General Assembly, where its Member Organizations come together to decide on the work programme, the strategic priorities and budget. The core of MIO-ECSDE is its Secretariat Team based in Athens, the Executive Bureau and its NGO Member Organizations. MIO-ECSDE has been recognised as a key international player in skilfully bringing together Mediterranean stakeholders on issues crucial for the sustainable future of the region. MIO-ECSDE facilitates four more networks of major Mediterranean stakeholders who play a key role in addressing the region’s environmental and sustainable development challenges: a network of Educators (MEdIES), a network of Parliamentarians (COMPSUD), a network of Journalists (COMJESD), a network of Universities (MedUnNet).

entityDescription:
Wireless and More designs, evaluates and implements solutions that address the various challenges posed by wireless communications in a wide variety of environments: from terrestrial radio links to underwater acoustic and optical communications. Wireless and More is a spin-off company of the University of Padova, and benefits from the interaction with the research groups at the University, through direct collaborations and knowledge transfer.
We have extensive experience in programming software and integrating systems in the area of wireless communications networks. We developed solutions that encompass radio, terrestrial and marine as well as underwater acoustic and optical networks, integrating commercial devices and software with cutting-edge communications protocols and architectures. The co-founders have also extensive experience in managing EU projects and collaborations with corporate research groups.

entityDescription:
Raytheon Technologies (NYSE: RTX) is an aerospace and defense company that provides advanced systems and services for commercial, military and government customers worldwide. The company was formed in 2020 through the combination of Raytheon Company and the United Technologies Corporation aerospace businesses, and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts.
Raytheon Technologies has over 195,000 employees globally, 60,000 of whom are Engineers, with 2019 pro forma combined annual revenue of $74B. The company is very proud of its 190+ years of combined innovation and industry leadership, with a portfolio of over 40,000 patents. Raytheon Technologies is defining the future of aerospace and defense, with ambitions technologies that push the limits of known science. Annual company- and customer-funded research and development is approximately $8B.
In Europe, Raytheon Technologies has over 25,000 employees, with significant design centers and manufacturing sites in Poland, France, Germany, Italy and the United Kingdom. 
Within its Technology and Global Engineering organisation, Raytheon Technologies operates a Corporate Research Centre, chartered with research and early development of critical technologies applicable to multiple businesses. This organization works with technology leaders across the company to develop an impactful corporate research portfolio and ensure efficient transition of technologies to the businesses. The Research Centre has a global footprint with locations in East Hartford, CT, Berkeley CA, Cork, Ireland, and Rome, Italy. It has approximately 500 employees, more than 400 of whom are professional scientists and engineers. 
United Technologies Research Centre Ireland, Ltd. (UTRC-I) is an affiliate of Raytheon Technologies. It was established in Cork in 2010 to operate as Raytheon Technologies European research hub, with a mission to develop advanced technologies – “what’s next” – for all the businesses of Raytheon Technologies, particularly those based in Europe, and to work with other industry, national labs and academic institutions to broaden the scope and impact of new technology developments along the value chain. 
In Ireland, the Research Center has approximately 75 employees who investigate the “what ifs” of power distribution, advanced propulsion, energy storage, autonomy and human-machine interaction and innovative aircraft systems. This application focus, coupled with the extensive experience of the Research Centre in system engineering, controls, modelling, formal methods, and embedded system development, its close-knit interaction with the diversity of Raytheon Technologies’ European businesses, ideally place the Research Center to lead participation in European research projects.

Raytheon Technologies has over 195,000 employees globally, 60,000 of whom are Engineers, with 2019 pro forma combined annual revenue of $74B. The company is very proud of its 190+ years of combined innovation and industry leadership, with a portfolio of over 40,000 patents. Raytheon Technologies is defining the future of aerospace and defense, with ambitions technologies that push the limits of known science. Annual company- and customer-funded research and development is approximately $8B.
In Europe, Raytheon Technologies has over 25,000 employees, with significant design centers and manufacturing sites in Poland, France, Germany, Italy and the United Kingdom. 
Within its Technology and Global Engineering organisation, Raytheon Technologies operates a Corporate Research Centre, chartered with research and early development of critical technologies applicable to multiple businesses. This organization works with technology leaders across the company to develop an impactful corporate research portfolio and ensure efficient transition of technologies to the businesses. The Research Centre has a global footprint with locations in East Hartford, CT, Berkeley CA, Cork, Ireland, and Rome, Italy. It has approximately 500 employees, more than 400 of whom are professional scientists and engineers. 
United Technologies Research Centre Ireland, Ltd. (UTRC-I) is an affiliate of Raytheon Technologies. It was established in Cork in 2010 to operate as Raytheon Technologies European research hub, with a mission to develop advanced technologies – “what’s next” – for all the businesses of Raytheon Technologies, particularly those based in Europe, and to work with other industry, national labs and academic institutions to broaden the scope and impact of new technology developments along the value chain. 
In Ireland, the Research Center has approximately 75 employees who investigate the “what ifs” of power distribution, advanced propulsion, energy storage, autonomy and human-machine interaction and innovative aircraft systems. This application focus, coupled with the extensive experience of the Research Centre in system engineering, controls, modelling, formal methods, and embedded system development, its close-knit interaction with the diversity of Raytheon Technologies’ European businesses, ideally place the Research Center to lead participation in European research projects.

entityDescription:
ROMARS is a new start-up company funded for the initiative of three university professors of University of Rome Tor Vergata.
The company’s main mission is to design and develop innovative telecommunication network architectures to provide multimedia services, aiming to optimizing performance through the utilization of several years research outcomes in terms of network protocols and resource management. In particular, also the tools developed in the last year and available at their laboratory represent a basement to validate solutions and optimise performance. The available test beds perfectly reproduce the telecommunication real environment allowing to test real applications and devices.
The experience of the three founders is focused on heterogeneous networks and 5G, with particular attention to virtualised network functions and orchestrations.
Romars people, in particular the three shareholders Michele Luglio, Cesare Roseti and Francesco Zampognaro, have a long experience in participating and coordinating international projects. So far, they participated in more than 20 ESA projects. In particular, in the last years they gained meaningful know how and developed innovative solutions in the frame of ESA project oriented to the use of satellite network in the forthcoming 5G system. The projects address the design, the implementation and the testing of technologies supporting the future convergence of satellite and terrestrial network in the frame of 5G concept. The most meaningful and recent ESA projects are ANCHoR, VIBeS, COMBO-SSB, and SHINE.

Romars, being a university spin off, is allowed to use the laboratory developed in the frame of the research projects so far carried out by the three founders.

entityName: Institute of Fluid-Flow Machinery Polish Academy of Sciences
entityDescription:
IMP–PAN belongs to the Polish Academy of Sciences and with over 200 staff members (over 140 scientific researchers including 20 professors, 45 post-doctoral scientists). The Institute was founded in 1956 and its main task is to conduct high quality research in the areas which are the focus of the world's science and technology. The most important fields of research are distributed heat and power generation on the small scale based on renewable resources, (m)CHP technology, plus energy technologies for private buildings, photovoltaics, exploitation and thermal-hydraulic diagnostics of steam turbines, machine mechanics (computer analysis, vibrations, rotor dynamics, model-based diagnostics, expert systems), high-temperature gasification and gas/syngas cogeneration, rotor dynamic modelling, design and testing, fuel cells and hydrogen/biogas cogeneration, new materials, condition monitoring and smart structures, plasma and laser engineering and small hydro power plants.
The Institute has a long track record in international cooperation, particularly in research and innovation projects, starting from FP5 until H2020, INTERREG, Norway Grants etc. Moreover, IMP PAN is a renowned research institution on national level, having coordinated a number of high budget R&D projects on RES technologies. Parallelly to scientific activities, a great attention is paid to strong relations with industry, resulting in joint innovation projects and technology development.

entityDescription:
As the manufacturer of long-range drones, the company name BOREAL, was given to its flagship product: the BOREAL drone. The first examples of these drones were intended for the scientific experimental market. The drone has a payload carrying capacity of up to 7 kg, maintains remarkable stability while flying and is highly modular. The BOREAL perfectly adapts to scientists needs. Our historical clients are Météo France, ONERA, the Aerology Laboratory and the CEA, who have all used the BOREAL UAV for experimental purposes.
 
A BOREAL Drone for Every Field of Application!
The BOREAL drone has been historically oriented towards science and is diversifying towards other markets. For example, maritime surveillance or even Earth observation applications – such as visible imagery or LiDAR – complement the BOREAL’s applications. Today, the company offers 3 drone versions for different civilian applications. Its modularity, compact size, 8-hour autonomy and great range, make it an ideal drone for highly demanding missions, such as reconnaissance, surveillance and data collection. BOREAL does not stop here: it also offers support service for getting-started and for training remote pilots in the operation of the systems.
Operational on All Terrains
The BOREAL drone takes off using a catapult and does not require any terrain preparation. In addition, the drone can adapt to difficult flight conditions. It can be deployed in rainy weather conditions as well as in winds of up to 70 km/h.

A "Made in Toulouse" Product
The company designs and manufactures its drones in its workshop located in Castanet-Tolosan (31), on the south-east side of Toulouse. The BOREAL company is part of the MISTRAL group along with its sister companies, M3 Systems France and M3 Systems Belgium. BOREAL uses GNSS Test & Measurement solutions offered by M3 Systems France as well as certain skills in the field of air traffic (Air Traffic Management: ATM) developed by M3 Systems Belgium on behalf of EUROCONTROL (European Agency for air navigation safety).

entityName: B R Aerospace Solutions and Services Inc
entityDescription:
B R Aerospace Solutions and Services Inc., (BRASS, Inc.), is established to provide innovative and efficient solutions for Earth Observation, in a cost-effective manner. BRASS Inc is founded with a vision to lead the Canadian downstream space sector on the global platform of Space Sector, from Competition to Cooperation via Contributions; by providing innovative solutions for the most complex challenges, for the betterment of mankind. At this stage, through our services in simulation and modeling, operations, planning and project management, mission designing...etc, in the domain of the advanced space systems, UAVs, Earth Observation and Satellite Operations, BRASS aims to actively engage with Canadian industry to strengthen the capacity building in the growing space sector; and to pursue advanced research and development through innovation, for the betterment of the people of Canada.

At BRASS Inc., what we do is:
a. Identify the operational gaps and serve as the link between institutions, academia, government, and industry.
b. Solve technical problems by addressing the gaps through testing, integration, validation and operations.
c. Fill gap with demonstrated analysis (through partners, connections, direct expertise, operations area...etc for immediate solutions)/consultancy.
d. Provide technical consultancy and offer training's, business support and project management, courses (with institutional partnership).
e. Our innovative solutions, derived by our diversified and vibrant team, improve efficiency and operational effectiveness (by reducing risk and increasing reliability of the services).

Our recently developed project Project APES (Accessible Platform From Earth to Space), through our patented technology, to utilize High Altitude Solar Powered Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (HASP-UAV) for Earth Observation (Resource mapping, Climate monitoring, Agriculture, and Irrigation) in Canada, we aim to provide an accessible platform from Earth to Space, with a vision to expand the scope of Space Technology in Canada and its applications used across the width and breadth of the economy of Canada and different participating sectors. BRASS Inc is also exploring various applications on Earth Observation, including in Agriculture, Resource Mapping, Marine Biology, Land use, Sea use applications...etc., using RCM / RADARSAT data for the Canadian Industries.

Beneficial Sectors: Agriculture, Environment, Natural Resources, Land and Mining, Oil and Gas, Marine, Communications, Search & Rescue, Defence...etc.

entityDescription:
Quantum Reversal Inc. (QR) operates in the information and wireless technology sector. QR develops an innovative wireless and antenna technologies for various commercial markets. The QR team has experience in designing products for various applications in space, underwater, robotics, UAV to commercial and user end. Each application requires specific solution in order to deal with specific environmental (i.e. pressure, temperature, vibration) and operational conditions. 
 
QR has developed a proprietary solution for an intentional jamming and unintentional RF interference of the GPS/GNSS signals in order to provide a robust GPS or GNSS navigation solution services such as timing and/or 3D position. The commercial market is the main target of QR novel anti-jamming products.
 
The current solution consists now of five products: 
· QR100 – GPS dual frequency L1/L2 anti-jamming unit
· QR200 – GPS dual frequency L1/L2 anti-jamming antenna
· QR101 – GNSS multi frequency bands anti-jamming unit
· QR201 – GNSS multi frequency bands anti-jamming antenna 
· QR202 – GNSS multi frequency band anti-jamming antenna with additional L-band reception (1520-1560 MHz)
 
All the products are lightweight (230 grams for QR1xx series and 500 grams for QR2xx series), low power consumption (1-1.5 Watt typical depend on the configuration) that are suitable to be mounted on any platform (cars, poles, drones, etc.).
 
The company sells stand alone products as well as OEM products that can be integrated within the customer products.

entityDescription:
Short introduction:
Aerodiagnostika (a.k.a. THRUST - Intelligent UAV Sysstems) is a startup developing drone / UAV based data gathering platform and integrating it with advanced analytics (including artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions). Our core innovation lies in our UAVs which are designed to fly low and slow in order to gather high quality data. Also, the design allows it to maintain long endurance endurance and cover up to300 km in one mission. So far, our main focus was in electricity grid diagnostics, however, we are currently developing solutions for agriculture (RGB+ multispectral cameras) and forestry (RGB + Multispectral + LiDAR). We see great potential in combining UAV (micro level) and satellite data (macro level) for remote sensing.

Our history:
AeroDiagnostika was founded in 2018 when a team of engineers led by Robertas Urbanavičius, a PhD with 40+ years of experience, applied know-how acquired in security & defense sector to create a superior drone for civilian data gathering purposes – GreenBee UAV. The company currently led by Daiva Urbanavičienė (repeatedly awarded as the best female CEO in Lithuania) successfully attracted €1.3M in R&D financing from various instruments, which allowed us to reach TRL7 – GreenBee prototype has been demonstrated and validated in actual operational environment with test flights and data collection performed in agriculture, environmental and power grid sectors. Our innovation and competitive advantage rely on our superior drones, however we see our core business as drone services and data analytics company. In 2020 Aerodiagnostika rebranded as THRUST – Intelligent UAV systems.

Our innovation:
Our drone is designed to gather maximum quality data: fly low and slow (43 km/h) while being stable and resistant to wind (20 m/s). Also, it can carry up to 8 kg of sensors and still weigh below 25 kg (civilian drone weight class). Furthermore, it has endurance of up to 8 hours and can cover up to 300 km in one mission, while still being green (0.35 l of fuel per h). Which gives us a competitive advantage against other UAVs and allows us to gather micro level data on large scale.

entityDescription:
Founded in 1994 MBN Nanomaterialia (www.mbn.it) is a producer of metal powder materials trough a proprietary mechano-chemical synthesis process technology (Mechanomade). Materials of MBN have an ultrafine crystalline structure which delivers unique physical and mechanical properties resulting in superior performance when compared to existing alloys. MBN powders consist in conventional micron-sized particles that do not contain any nano-sized particulates and can be safely utilized in the mainstream industries by powder metallurgy processes, spraying coating and laser AM.
Main products lines range from ferrous and nonferrous alloys for cutting tools to Titanium based alloys for biomedical prosthesis and ODS alloys for high temperature resistance components (aerospace, energy). MBN is also a producer of customized materials for additive manufacturing based on Titanium Alluminides and high purity composites for sputtering targets and thermal spraying powders for coatings.
As far as it concerns powder used for AM laser processing, the engineering and development is totally accomplished in-house, without or partially resorting to powder end user’s facilities, thanks to the availability of a laser deposition MLD and spraying job-shop.
MBN is a ISO 9001:2008 certified company which ensure the supply of high quality grade raw materials for the industry. MBN is also a validated supplier of biomedical Titanium powder conforming standard specification ASTM F1580-12. 
The MBN team is a specialist in advance material manufacturing and have an extensive experience in project leadership and management for large research and development projects.

That’s why the company has been branded “asvin”.

Unpatched and less secured devices are prio targets for botnet operators to capture and get control devices. - Easy Implementation
Ready to run libraries and API’s for IoT operators to connect asvin.io update solution on embedded systems
- Risk Reduction
Smart Industry can reduce security risk of their business application by using asvin.io approved security architecture and advances cyberthreat analytics
-Cost reduction
Using asvin as a Service (SaaS) IoT Operators safe spending’s on own update platform development and maintenance

- Reliable solution
The asvin Open Source Model provides IoT operators the ability for fallbacks by independent operation of update service

entityDescription: AMIGO s.r.l. is the first Italian SME working on climate service. The company was founded by two climate experts with 20-years of experience in 2013, starting for the idea that there was a lack of an easy-to-use solution for the climate risk assessment. The limitations of existing solutions motivated Sandro Calmanti and Marcello Petitta to begin the journey that brought AMIGO from an R&D project funded by the UN World Food Programme to finalizing AMIGOclimate, proprietary AI-powered software to support Insurance and Reinsurance companies to manage climate risk. During the last 7 years of intense R&D activity, AMIGO has designed three other innovative modular plugins for the quality control and the spacial refinement of climate data, and for the risk assessment over seasonal time-horizons. Parallel to the R&D projects, AMIGO has been heavily active in consultancy for international organisations, gaining, among other tenders, two 3+1 year Long Term Agreements with the UN World Food Programme in 2015. AMIGO was also one of 6 teams winning the 1st European Data Incubator in 2019. The company is currently involved in four H2020 projects on climate services for the insurance market, the aviation sector, the rural development and infrastructure management. All this was possible thanks to a highly motivated, multi-disciplinary team of experts guided by the CEO, Sara Dal Gesso. The core expertise of the AMIGO team ranges from climate science to Big Data and AI, from software development to socio-economic assessment, from strategic design to business development. AMIGOclimate is the innovative software at the heart of the company's strategy of growth and internationalisation, being the key asset to scale-up from a consultancy SME to a software service provider to large enterprises. With this software solution, AMIGO aims to become the European leader in the market of climate services for the insurance sector, hence taking part in the continental effort for a resilient society under the umbrella of the European Green Deal.

Company description: AMIGO s.r.l. is the first Italian SME working on climate service. The company was founded by two climate experts with 20-years of experience in 2013, starting for the idea that there was a lack of an easy-to-use solution for the climate risk assessment. The limitations of existing solutions motivated Sandro Calmanti and Marcello Petitta to begin the journey that brought AMIGO from an R&D project funded by the UN World Food Programme to finalizing AMIGOclimate, proprietary AI-powered software to support Insurance and Reinsurance companies to manage climate risk. During the last 7 years of intense R&D activity, AMIGO has designed three other innovative modular plugins for the quality control and the spacial refinement of climate data, and for the risk assessment over seasonal time-horizons. Parallel to the R&D projects, AMIGO has been heavily active in consultancy for international organisations, gaining, among other tenders, two 3+1 year Long Term Agreements with the UN World Food Programme in 2015. AMIGO was also one of 6 teams winning the 1st European Data Incubator in 2019. The company is currently involved in four H2020 projects on climate services for the insurance market, the aviation sector, the rural development and infrastructure management. All this was possible thanks to a highly motivated, multi-disciplinary team of experts guided by the CEO, Sara Dal Gesso. The core expertise of the AMIGO team ranges from climate science to Big Data and AI, from software development to socio-economic assessment, from strategic design to business development. AMIGOclimate is the innovative software at the heart of the company's strategy of growth and internationalisation, being the key asset to scale-up from a consultancy SME to a software service provider to large enterprises. With this software solution, AMIGO aims to become the European leader in the market of climate services for the insurance sector, hence taking part in the continental effort for a resilient society under the umbrella of the European Green Deal.

10 10 - One Object One Owner S.B. S.r.l. was established in 29/03/2019 by a group of 5 professionals with different backgrounds. Company’s primary goal is to provide an IoT platform to customers – business and common users – which enables total control on smart objects embedding 10 10 technology. The platform is connected to a decentralised, independent blockchain where relevant information will be stored, thus guaranteeing the highest level of transparency and reliability. 10 10 provides both hardware and software solutions to transform common-use objects – bicycle, clothes, music instruments, etc. – into connected smart-objects. Producers, sellers and owners will be able to interact with these objects in many different ways thanks to the app developed by 10 10.
10 10 - One Object One Owner is also a Pending B Corporation, where its mission is to create non-intrusive intelligent and environmentally sustainable objects. The company has therefore established a fruitful cooperation with the Universities of Parma and Bologna, to carry on research activities in the energy field in order to create totally autonomous smart objects, capable to harvest the energy they need to communicate from the environment. Among these activities, the development ofinnovative graphene super-capacitors and nanogenerators that will allow 10 10 objects to work without requiring any external energy supply.

entityDescription:
W4E is a spin-off company of the Offshore Renewable Energy’s research group led by Prof. Giuliana Mattiazzo from Politecnico di Torino and boasts more then 10 years of experience in the field of marine energy. The company pursues the challenge of creating new opportunities for clean and sustainable energy supply from the most promising resources on the planet. Generate electricity from the waves is in fact one of the biggest challenges today.
Since its inception, the main efforts of W4E were directed to the creation of Wave Energy Converter (WEC) devices. Starting from the optimization of control algorithms and arriving at the study of interactions with the marine environment, W4E has developed an innovative proprietary technology called ISWEC (Inertial Sea Wave Energy Converter).
Being able to instal a full scale ISWEC, W4E has grown expertise in multidisciplinary fields ranging from mechanical to electrical engineering, from wave dynamics to mooring architectures, from legislation to environmental aspects, from politics to regulation plans for the grid connection, from the forecast to offshore operations and much more.
During its growth, W4E has faced typical problems of the offshore energy industry, having to deal with the aggressive marine environment. Only the partnership with other experienced companies in such an industry has allowed the company to achieve successful results. The collaboration with Eni allowed the launch of an industrialization plan that today has made technology jump from TRL 5 to TRL 7 in just two years.
The objectives and the steps forward to bring ISWEC to a TRL 9 are clear and already planned. Thanks to previous experiences, today W4E is a company that works in the field of innovative engineering and technology transfer, with the aim of developing complex technological solutions with the focus on energy supply systems from renewable sources in an offshore environment.

With operations in Europe and Main Offices in Germany, Italy and the UK Reply is a company that specialises in Consulting, Systems Integration and Digital Services with a focus on the conception, design and implementation of solutions based on the new communication channels and digital media. Reply partners with key industrial groups in defining and developing business models made possible by the new technological and communication paradigms such as Big Data, Cloud Computing, Digital Communication, the Internet of Things and Mobile and Social Networking. In so doing, it aims to optimise and integrate processes, applications and devices. Given its knowledge of specific solutions and due to a consolidated experience, Reply addresses the main core issues of the various industrial sectors. Reply’s offer covers three areas of competence: Processes – for Reply the understanding and the use of technology involves the introduction of a new enabling factor for business processes, based on an in-depth knowledge of both the market and the specific industrial contexts of implementation; Applications – Reply designs and develops application solutions aimed at meeting core business needs; Technologies – Reply optimises the use of innovative technologies, creating solutions that are capable of guaranteeing maximum operational efficiency and flexibility for its clients. entityName: TITANIA, ENSAYOS Y PROYECTOS INDUSTRIALES S.L.
entityDescription:
"TITANIA, Ensayos y Proyectos Industriales S.L.", is a “spin-off“ company (SME) emerging from the Research Activities of the Group of Corrosion and Protection (LABCYP) of the University of Cádiz (UCA). Established in 2006, TITANIA focuses its activities on the quality control of materials and the development of R&D project for the Aerospace Industry, and to a lesser extent in the study and quality control works for the Maritime and Automobile Industry. The company is sustainably growing from its foundation. Currently, TITANIA has around 60 employees and it is located in the Tecnobahía technology park in El Puerto de Santa Maria (Cádiz) with more than 2,500 m2 of full equipped laboratories.
The capabilities of TITANIA cover most of the materials that are part of an airplane: metals, fasteners, composites, paints, sealants and adhesives. TITANIA has different technical units or laboratories that perform the characterization of its properties: mechanical laboratories, microscopy, corrosion, climate, surface and union, physical-chemical, thermal analysis and non-destructive testing technologies. TTITANIA has the approval of major aeronautical manufacturers such as AIRBUS GROUP (by its three divisions), BOMBARDIER, EMBRAER, BOEING and SIKORSKY, as well as recognition of their technical competence by ENAC/ILAC (ISO 17025) and NADCAP accreditation entities (MTL, NMMT and NDT). These capabilities enable TITANIA to have a regular R&D activity at national level so that it participates in the development of projects with leading companies in the aeronautical sector, expanding its research activity to other sectors such as the naval, energy or infrastructure.

Currently, the company is spreading its field of action, being space on of the most relevant new sectors to focus on.

entityDescription:
bettereco provides first international B2B - organic agriculture trading platform with full traceability to fields on blockchain technology (farm to fork) and provides first European wide solution. 

Food matters any time and everywhere. The procurement methods have not been updated the last 50 years, but demand and regulations have increased. The modernization of the procurement is important for the food-, cosmetic- and phytopharma industry as food, especially organic food are in high demand. For the agriculture commodities we develop a digital procurement ecosystem in order to open new sources of international supply of agriculture raw-materials, while at the same time ensuring traceability and therefore food safety. Our system is applicable also to the food meat and conventional food industry, but also other industries. We are interested in exploring Satellite Earth Observation for implementing a double check system of our local tracing system and controlling the sustainable practices in order to avoid deforestation and keep biodiversity. The betterECO platform is a hyperscaleable ecosystems, on which other service provider such as organic control bodies, logistics etc. can add on to facilitate international agriculture raw material trade under a controlled and traceable manner.
The platform of betterECO aims
a) to modernize procurement, especially needed in the current crisis times, as meeting and fairs or trade via middlemen leads to market distortions, misallocations and intransparency and avoid therefore traceability
b) to provide access to all market players internationally which stimulates trade due to easy access for im and export, provides variety of products and chances for more equal income distribution
c) and can be used also for other industries (airplane construction, spare parts)
d) ) to fulfil the planned Lieferkettengesetz (= Supply Chain Law) in Germany.

BforCure is an innovative company created in 2018 by spin-off from Elvesys, a world leader inthe development of high-precision microfluidic flow control instruments. BforCure develop the FASTGENE technology for ultra-rapid detection of DNA sequences by polymerase chainreaction (PCR). BforCure is created by Dr. Le Berre and Dr. Pannetier, who developed a panel of innovative technologies for biological diagnostic which have been granted by the French defense innovation Agency in 2020 with a 2M� funding for the development of an operational, mobile, modular and connected solution making it possible to carry out decentralized screening of people suspected of being carriers of the SARS-CoV-2 virus (NOMORECOV); in 2017 the French Bank of Investment (Bpifrance) granted BforCure with an 8 m� funding to become a “future potential leader of the diagnostic market”. Foodini will revolutionize every kitchen, outpacing the functionality of the last kitchen revolution: the microwave. entityName: IFER - Ustav pro vyzkum lesnich ekosystemu, s.r.o.
entityDescription:
IFER - Institute of Forest Ecosystem Research, s.r.o., is an independent, private research organization. The core activities of the company are primarily focused on forest production ecology, monitoring of forest health condition, methods of statistical forest inventory, forest management planning, wildlife ecology, balance of carbon and other substances in ecosystems, etc. IFER is capable of independent work at research tasks in these fields on the basis of current assignments of clients from amongst the Czech and foreign forest owners and managers, ministries, state administration and self-governments, the European Union and other international organizations and institutions. IFER is functioning with no basic budget or institutional contribution; its existence depends exclusively on the receipts from individual projects. 
During its existence, IFER gained a lot of theoretical knowledge as well as practical experience which facilitate a long-term development of the methodology of statistical forest inventory and a closely linked complex technology of computer aided collection and processing of field data – Field-Map. The development and subsequent trading with the Field-Map technology was assigned to a spinoff limited company IFER – Monitoring and Mapping Solutions, s.r.o. founded for the purpose in 2005.
From its foundation until today, IFER – Institute of Forest Ecosystem Research – resolved more than 220 research projects – from purely domestic assignments through international projects up to those resolved and implemented abroad only. IFER can resolve research tasks falling into the sphere of basic research as well as practice-oriented technical jobs. In the last few years, IFER’s portfolio of activities was extended by tasks falling into the sphere of decision- and policy-making (e.g. expert counselling for state administration or ministries, preparation of documents for agendas relating to international conventions, etc.).
The center of IFER’s activities lies in forestry, at all levels of the science – forest operations (logging, silviculture, etc.), forest management, monitoring of protected areas, forest policy, administration of databases, development of computer programs for the forest industry and many others. IFER has long been dealing also with the issue of climate change and with the related monitoring of carbon stock and inventory of the emissions of greenhouse gases. At present, IFER focuses on developing practically applicable systems and utilities capable of continuously updating data of forest management plans and last but not least on developing effective methods of studying the production potential of forests.
The background of theoretical knowledge and practical experience in all these disciplines made it possible for the Institute of Forest Ecosystem Research to develop on a long-term basis a methodology for statistical forest survey on the principles of which dwell today the solutions of most of its research projects. For the needs of forest inventory, IFER developed and is continually improving a complex technology for the collection of field data and their subsequent processing – Field-Map.

entityDescription: Electric mobility and next-generation electronics are redefining industries, but as devices become smaller, more powerful, and wirelessly connected, electromagnetic interference (EMI) is reaching critical levels. Traditional metal-based shielding is heavy, rigid, and expensive, struggling to meet the demands of the modern era. The world needs a paradigm shift—one that delivers superior shielding performance while enabling lighter, more sustainable, and scalable solutions. The answer is graphene. Graphenest’s advanced graphene-based EMI shielding materials replace conventional metals, offering unprecedented flexibility, weight reduction, and manufacturing efficiency. Engineered for industries like automotive, aerospace, and high-performance electronics, Graphenest’s proprietary technology delivers over 30 dB of attenuation with a seamless integration process. Our conductive coatings and composite solutions bring a new level of performance to EMI shielding, enhancing durability, design freedom, and cost-effectiveness. By eliminating the limitations of legacy shielding methods, Graphenest enables thinner, lighter, and more sustainable devices—paving the way for faster, more efficient, and greener electronics. With a robust ecosystem of partners and a cutting-edge production process, we’re not just improving shielding. We’re redefining it.

entityDescription:
PSI was founded in 1987 with the goal of developing gas atomised metal powders for the then-emerging Hot Isostatic Pressing (HIP) industry. entityName: AECSIC - Centro de Investigaciones Biológicas Margarita Salas
entityDescription:
The Center for Biological Research (CIB) is one of the most prestigious and historical research centers of the Spanish National Research Council (CSIC). Generations of distinguished scientists have carried out their research since the Center’s foundation in 1953, and new scientists continue to be trained there. In 2019, in homage to one of the most important researchers in the history of the CIB, where she spent a total of 13 years, and of Spanish molecular biology, the CIB was renamed the Margarita Salas Center for Biological Research.
Currently, the CIB Margarita Salas is organized into four departments, in which researchers study the structure and organization of living matter and its processes, seek to understand the bases of disease and discover experimental treatments and develop biotechnological processes to enable sustainable growth and facilitate agricultural production. We combine the generation of new knowledge with the development of applications that can help solve current and future challenges facing society.
The CSIC participates in a series of initiatives to combat the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, the cause of the COVID-19 pandemic. The CIB Margarita Salas actively collaborates in these initiatives through a range of diverse activities. In addition, researchers from our center form part of the Global Health Platform created by the CSIC and are currently working on more than ten coronavirus-related scientific projects.

We combine the generation of new knowledge with the development of applications that can help solve current and future challenges facing society.
The CSIC participates in a series of initiatives to combat the SARS-CoV-2 coronavirus, the cause of the COVID-19 pandemic. The CIB Margarita Salas actively collaborates in these initiatives through a range of diverse activities. In addition, researchers from our center form part of the Global Health Platform created by the CSIC and are currently working on more than ten coronavirus-related scientific projects.

entityDescription:
Infinitivity Design Labs (IDL) is an SME studio based in the rural area of the French region of Auvergne, focusing on designing sustainable, meaningful and intrinsically motivating learning experiences, placing education and training in the spotlight of its core mission. The studio is also a French state certified professional training organization (DataDock), compliant with official onboarding, delivery and evaluation training standards. IDL focuses on three key activities: game-based learning, instructional design & training and usability. 
The studio has designed or provided consulting services around a variety of educational games for mobile devices, desktop computers, motion sensor controls, AR/VR technologies as well as interactive tabletops and surfaces. The studio is behind the LUDUS project award winning mobile game Ladybug’s Box: Early Childhood Mathematics for mobile tablet devices, the interactive video crowdsourcing platform ActivePlay and the transmedia project Koders, aiming at promoting a healthy image of coding to young audiences. IDL designs and facilitates playful workshops with participants of various age groups, using digital, physical and outdoor games as tools for learning.
 
IDL also focuses on instructional design by designing and developing Learning Management Systems (LMS) and relevant content. IDL works with Subject Matter Experts in order to identify requirements, define learning objectives, specify target audiences, define teaching and learning strategies, which encompass aspects like technical infrastructure, learning theories, assessment, content tools as well as the development of resources themselves. 
 
In the field of usability and user experience, IDL provides consulting services to various non-profit and for-profit organizations, like Disney, Technicolor and Amadeus IT. IDL promotes an ethical approach to design, which focuses on the impact of design decisions on culture and society and the repercussions of their application. IDL provides trainings around Design Thinking, Lean UX, the Double Diamond and the impact of design on digital cultures and ethics, during which participants focus on creating meaningful experiences for their users and the societies which they live in. 
 
Usability and learnability are two key aspects of IDL’s focus, which conducts user research in order to improve the overall learning and user experience of different types of interfaces and platforms. IDL provides web accessibility trainings and conducts web accessibility reviews, aiming at an equitable distribution of information and resources.

entityDescription:
UAB „Gruppo FOS Lithuania“ (FOS LT), established in 2015, is working in R&D, Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, Technology Transfer areas. Company works in partnership with leading Italian and Lithuanian research institutions in joint laboratories. Lithuanian Universities (KTU, LSMU), Italian Universities (University of Genoa, University of Salerno), ENEA are the partners of FOS LT. It has a strong experience in the international projects in healthcare sector. FOS LT successfully implemented „Biomedical electronic device for brainstroke monitoring“ project and has already acquired a patent “A method and biomedical electronic equipment thereof for monitoring human condition after stroke.” Project of “Multi-modal system for personalized management of the post stroke recovery” was selected to be financed from „Intelektas. Joint science-business projects” program and is successfully implemented with 2 Lithuanian Universities (KTU and LSMU).
FOS LT is a daughter company of Gruppo FOS, Italian company, which works in IT, Automation, Engineering and Communication sectors and is specializing in the design and development of IT solutions and offers a vast number of services to its clients. The services are provided both in “as a service” mode for the maintenance of systems and new developments at the customer’s premises, and through the design and realization of tailored “on demand” solutions (software applications, db and systemic assistance, cyber security, cloud computing, digital workspace and hardware supply). 
Gruppo FOS has got technological competences certified with the major providers of software design, software application, database and application server.
Gruppo FOS developed competences since more than 15 years in the field of Internet of Things (IoT), Smart Devices and in general provide software and support to develop solutions to allow the control of devices in a distributed system. Gruppo FOS has participated in many projects that involved IoT technology. Specifically, in the ISAAC project (ISAAC - Innovativo Sistema illuminotecnico per l’Allevamento di vegetali in Ambienti Chiusi per migliorare il benessere umano), FOS developed with partners ENEA (Agenzia nazionale per le nuove tecnologie e lo sviluppo economico sostenibile) and BECAR (BECAR s.r.l subsidiary of BEGHELLI group) a system named Microcomo. Microcosmo is a Field simulation system as a technological solution to study the growth of plants subjected to experimental conditions, it is a complete two area system, one epigean area where is growing the leaves part of the plant and the hypogeum area where the roots of the plant are growing. Both areas are controlled for cooling, heating, humidity and few other parameters and epigean area is controlled for light conditions with 5 Colors LED Panels too.

entityName: CREA - Consiglio per la ricerca in agricoltura e l'analisi dell'economia agraria
entityDescription:
We are the leading Italian research organization dedicated to the agri-food supply chains. We operate as a legal entity under public law, and are supervised by the Ministry of Agricultural, Food, Forestry and Tourism Policies (Mipaaft). Our scientific activity covers agricultural crops, livestock, fishery, forestry, agro-industry, food science – and socio-economics . We have full scientific, statutory, organizational, administrative and financial autonomy. CREA was established in 2015, from the merging of CRA (Council for Agricultural Research) and INEA (National Institute of Agricultural Economics), two country-wide institutions active since mid of last century”.

We employ over 2000 people, half of whom are researchers and technologists.
We possess several farms and experimental fields, allowing us to carry out our studies in the same conditions farmers operate under. This enable us to validate the results of our researches, verifying their feasibility and to ease dissemination to the final users.
In 2015, we became CREA, former Council for Agricultural Research – CRA, a country-wide institution. The new organization foresees12 research centers (6 related to specific supply chains and 6 dedicated to horizontal topics) which are forming a capillary network of structures throughout the country. The reform of the Institution has allowed to rationalize financial and personnel resources, forming the critical mass needed to deliver cutting edge research results.

entityDescription:
Maxwell Applied Technologies is specialized in the design and development of highly innovative and advanced solutions for electronic applications in the digital, RF and microwave field, by exploiting the simulation capabilities of the most advanced EDA tools. Inhereted from the technological knowledge and experience gained from Televes Corporation, which created a strong R&D department in 1971 with the aim of positioning products and solutions at the forefront of technology and innovation.
SERVICES AND SOLUTIONS

- Design & Simulation: We offer design and simulation services for electronic applications, including RF & microwave subsystems, power and signal integrity simulation for high speed digital designs and thermal analysis of electronic systems, by taking advantage of the most advanced simulation tools (such as CST Microwave Studio or ADS).

- Manufacturing: Televes, the brand heading the group of companies of which Maxwell is part, has been driven towards industrial investment since its creation. At this point in time, we have undertaken the challenge of developing a fully automated Industry 4.0 ecosystem in which components, processes, workers and customers create a dynamic and sustainable technological environment. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities include the latest generation of SMT assembly lines with the capability of mounting bare MMIC dies using pillar bump technology.

- Test & Characterization: Maxwell develops full turn-key services to customers that include test, characterization and verification processes of electronic systems in state-of-the-art facilities. We perform a broad range of product testing processes: from electromagnetic compatibility, or electrical safety to testing operating temperatures, resistance and humidity. We also carry out aging tests in extreme environments, or a vibration room to simulate the impact of adverse conditions.

EXPERTISE AND CAPABILITIES

- RF & Microwave: Design of a broad variety of antennas, (from dipoles, patches, horns, reflectors to electronic beam steering phase arrays), amplification systems (from Low Noise amplifiers to Power amplifiers exploiting state-of-the-art technologies such as Asymmetric Doherty amplifiers), passive components (filters, couplers, multiplexers…), integrated assemblies as well as custom MMIC design in III-V technologies. Our team has broad experience in the design of passive hardware and antennas for satellite applications (communications, navigation or scientific satellites). Working with several technologies from UHF frequency bands up to Q/V bands. They are also experienced on GSTP and ARTES programs development.

- Electronic Boards & Digital Systems: Our expertise is mainly focused on Signal Integrity, Power Integrity and EMI simulation and analysis of integrated circuits and printed circuit boards (PCBs). We also perform design and simulation of digital communication systems, including a wide variety of signal processing blocks such as digital filters, adaptive systems or digital automatic gain controls. Maxwell is also specialized in the development of digital systems on high performance FPGAs and high speed DACs/ADCs.

- Electronic thermal Analysis: We provide heat transfer and dynamic fluid simulations for optimal thermal design of integrated circuits, PCBs and electronic subsystems by exploiting most advanced CFD techniques.

entityDescription:
NONPARTISAN EXPERT ACTIVITY
Specializing in making strategic recommendations, our Institute lays down the paths for the advancement of key public policies offering substantive support for Polish and European decision-makers alike. Our think tank fellows produce nonpartisan and independent reports and analyses, and their conclusions are an essential source of information for the private sector and civil society.
As a leader among Polish non-governmental organisations, the Kosciuszko Institute runs a range of national and international projects devoted to multifaceted aspects of security, including energy and economic security as well as cybersecurity. Engaging key policy and business stakeholders, the representatives of international organisations and the NGO sector in collaborative efforts, our Institute initiates socio-political debate on the most pressing challenges facing Poland and Europe.
Due to its leadership position, our think tank attracts the best analysts from all over the world to launch multiple pioneering and innovative ventures. The Kosciuszko Institute is the originator and organiser of the European Cybersecurity Forum – CYBERSEC, an annual conference dedicated to the strategic aspects of cyberspace. The first edition of the event was held in 2015. Recognising its pivotal role as a platform for regular dialogue between key stakeholders, Concise Courses has ranked the event among the top five cybersecurity conferences in Europe. As part of the CYBERSEC initiative, we have also rolled out a national edition of the conference: the Polish Cybersecurity Forum – CYBERSEC PL.
TRUSTED PARTNER
For over 15 years, the Kosciuszko Institute has put consistent effort into building close and durable relationships with a wide array of actors for whom our country’s dynamic development, political and economic stability and security have become their highest priority.
Among the numerous partners collaborating with our Institute, we should mention Polish and European public institutions, international organisations, national champions representing different sectors of the economy, world’s business leaders, top-tier think tanks from Poland and abroad, and the most influential, opinion-forming media.
A network of institutions which act as patrons for the Institute’s initiatives and projects includes the European Parliament, the European Commission, NATO, the Chancellery of the Prime Minister of Poland, the Chancellery of the President of Poland, the National Security Bureau, the Ministry of Economic Development, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Poland, the Ministry of National Defence, the Ministry of Digital Affairs, the Ministry of the Interior and Administration, the Ministry of Science and Higher Education, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Construction, the Ministry of Finance, the Government Security Centre, the Supreme Audit Office, the Ministry of Energy, the National Public Prosecutor’s Office, and the World Bank.

STEP RI is a science and technology park established in 2008 by the University of Rijeka in order to become the premier science and technology hub and to foster cooperation between the academia and the business sector. STEP RI is a recognized centre for innovative and entrepreneurial support infrastructure of the Ministry of Economy of the Republic of Croatia, a member of the National network of BSOs (BOND) and a partner in the Croatian EEN consortium, offering its advisory services and practical support to clients from Croatia or clients interested in doing business in Croatia.
STEP RI is providing educational programs based on global up-to-date best practices such as: design thinking, creation of disruptive and sustainable innovations – products and services, product and business model innovation, pricing strategies, crowdfunding, business transfer and servitization. Since 2013 we have provided business consultation to more than 1.500 companies, scientists and start-ups and organized various events and workshops (350+ trainings for more than 6.000 participants), which makes us a major regional provider of business know-how. Proficio is an award-winning managed security services provider (MSSP), delivering 24/7 security monitoring and managed detection and response (MDR) services to organizations around the world. Since Proficio was founded ten years ago, we have grown significantly. Today we help enterprises across multiple industries by providing the highest level of cybersecurity protection at an affordable cost.
Proficio’s team of security experts works around-the-clock from our Security Operations Centers (SOCS) in San Diego, Singapore, and Barcelona monitoring security events and hunting for targeted attacks. We use a combination of propriety tools and industry-leading security technologies to detect threats and contain attacks before they can cause damage.

Proficio invented the concept of SOC-as-a-Service to describe how clients benefit from 24/7 monitoring and the same advanced threat detection technology that is used in sophisticated SOCs serving large enterprises and governments. Our mission is to deliver these capabilities to our clients without the cost and complexity associated with building a 24/7 SOC. Before the acronyms MDR and SOAR were created, Proficio was providing our clients Active Defense – an automated response service to contain threats in real-time.
Proficio has been highlighted in Gartner’s MDR Service Guide annually since 2017 and was also the first MSSP to provide cybersecurity business intelligence. Our patent-pending risk scoring algorithm quantifies risk based on applied security and shows industry peer group comparisons of overall risk.

Company description: METID (Methods and Innovative Technologies for Learning, https://www.metid.polimi.it/) is the “Innovation Teaching and Learning Center” of the Politecnico di Milano (https://www.polimi.it/). 
We design and test methods and tools for learning innovation and faculty development.
METID operates since 1996 taking part in numerous international networks and supporting teachers through an ecosystem of formal and informal resources. The ecosystem intersects consultancy activities in the design phase and monitoring activities of innovative teaching actions within curricular courses. 
For the faculty development METID mainly provides:
- Massive Online Open Courses dedicated to teacher training on the MOOCs portal of the Politecnico di Milano (POK-Polimi Open Knowledge https://www.pok.polimi.it/);

- Methodological support to the University to move activities and teaching dynamics from frontal lessons to online lessons sharing with teachers good practices for distance learning;
- International Seminars dedicated to structured training with an active class dimension.
METID also deals with learning spaces and innovative technologies: the development of effective innovative teaching strategies requires digital infrastructures and spaces for learning that support the development of the “active classroom” with small, medium-sized and large classes. 
Digital technologies make possible the creation of a new relationship with contents and change their role in the learning experience by becoming drivers of new teaching approaches. So, in addition to keep studying new technologies that could enrich the teaching and learning experiences, METID also provides online learning with the MOOCs platform POK. The online courses are designed to support students in the key steps of their career, to promote learning innovation and to spread knowledge for an informed citizenship.

entityDescription:
KING ICT is a regional systems integrator, and the leader in developing and implementing innovative enterprise solutions. Our primary drivers are knowledge, expertise, creativity and motivation to improve businesses and to create added value. Through innovative ICT solutions, we aim to build a more connected and digital future for our generation and future generations.
Our approach 
New technologies, combined with our knowledge, skills and individualised approach enable us to develop solutions that contribute to the quality of operations, and correspond to customer needs. We offer support and consultation services on digital transformation, through the implementation of adequate technological solutions.
Customers
The solutions we deliver range from highly specialised ones to those used by a great number of people in everyday life. Our customers come from a range of different branches, such as transport, energy, agriculture, health care, education, judiciary, trade, finance, telecommunications and many others. Our goal is to build a connected and digital future for our generation and future generations.
Solutions
Our innovative enterprise solutions are based on new technologies, cloud and mobile first principles. We develop and integrate solutions such as ERP, DMS or CRM, and products for managing employee efficiency such as HRplus. We build data centres, optimise IT infrastructure, implement security solutions and research and develop new ways of managing information, which has led to the creation of systems such as the BI system for business reporting and the GIS solution for the exchange of spatial data.
International standards 
Customer satisfaction is one of our main priorities and the foundation of our operations. All business processes have been aligned with international standards. Our quality control system has been designed in accordance with the principles and requirements laid down by the ISO 9001 international norm. For all processes, we ensure levels of quality control and information security, as prescribed by the international norm for managing information security 27001. We also care for the environment, the impacts of operations on the environment, and the legacy we leave to future generations. Therefore, our operations are also in compliance with the ISO 14001 environmental management international certificate.
Compliance with recommendations 
All project phases are executed in compliance with the recommendations of the methods PMI, ITIL, IPMA and Agile. We have a business security certificate pursuant to the Act on Degrees of Information Security TAJNO (National level TAJNO, NATO SECRET, EU SECRET). Our operations are also aligned with the legal regulations of the Republic of Croatia in the areas of technical protection.

Fondazione Giacomo Brodolini S.r.l. SB (FGB SRL SB) is a research centre inspired by the principles of labour and social inclusion, welfare promotion, territorial cohesion, sustainability, and technological innovation to boost economic growth, attention to the environment, access to employment through new skills, gender and cultural diversity and respect for fundamental human rights, and participation for local development.
The main purpose of FGB SRL SB is the creation of social impact through promotion of study and research, design and evaluation of public policies, planning of actions, and education and cultural production, which have an impact on the territories, organisations, and people forming the community in which the company grows and operates at national and international level. 
FGB SRL SB provides services and consultancy for: a) the analysis and evaluation of public policies and of public and private programmes and projects; b) research and analysis of data; c) the development of territorial networks; d) the provision of vocational education for both public and private bodies; e) the study and development of analysis and forecast models for the design and implementation of public policies; f) the development of models to measure the social economic impact, as well as the study and development of new models of active policies to meet the present and future economic and social needs and to overcome inequalities; g) support and advice to public and private entities operating in the same sectors and with the same purposes, also with the development and support of public/private partnership models for the management of interventions, and the implementation of innovative policies; and h) the publication and dissemination of studies and research on the topics mentioned above. FGB SRL SB furthermore provides cultural and advisory services to the public administration for: institutional communication; the organisation of events and dissemination of public, employment, training, inclusion and welfare, innovation, and social cohesion policies; and the promotion of territorial cooperation activities at national and transnational level.

entityDescription:
Secondary education in Đurđevac, Vocational School Đurđevac
Modern high school education in Đurđevac began in 1964 with the founding of the Gymnasium. In 1971, additional education was introduced for trades in mechanical engineering, wood processing and electrical engineering, for the professions of car mechanic, carpenter and electronics. With the reform of education in 1977, the last grade of the Gymnasium was completed and a general secondary school with two grades of preparatory degree and a final degree in occupations was introduced. Since 1980, high school education in Đurđevac has been taking place in the new, current school building.
By the decision of the Municipal Assembly of Đurđevac, in 1993 the Vocational School Đurđevac and the Gymnasium Dr. Ivana Kranjčeva Đurđevac, and since then in the same school building each school works as an independent institution. Since then, the Đurđevac vocational school has grown, both in terms of the number of students and the number of teachers, and in parallel in terms of the number of occupations. All this resulted in the need to invest in premises and equipment, which was ongoing.
At the Vocational School in Đurđevac, 520 students are currently educated in 30 classes in 16 occupations: computer technician, mechatronics technician, economist, CNC operator, locksmith, car mechanic, installer. heating and air conditioning, car mechanic, electronics mechanic, carpenter, cook, waiter, motor vehicle driver, hairdresser, beautician and assistant chef and pastry chef /to.
Đurđevac Vocational School currently employs 85 staff, of which 70 are teachers. With its human resources, the Đurđevac Vocational School is able to respond to the challenges of modern education and the reforms that are already being implemented. Proof of this can be found in numerous projects and activities that the school carries out outside the regular education programs, and again with the aim of improving the knowledge and skills of students in the occupations for which they are studying. The school actively participates in competitions, both in occupations and in general education subjects from school, through county, all the way to the state level. entityDescription:
WaterShed Monitoring Europe is a provider of innovative technology-based solutions and expertise for water quality data acquisition, storing and analyzing, from the source to the tap.
Organizations involved in water management often struggle with getting reliable assessment and control of water quality from the drainage basin to the treatment plant and the distribution system. The classical approach to water quality data management is ill-suited to meeting urban planning, scientific research and resources monitoring needs as it is still done in silos. In response to this challenge, Watershed Monitoring developed a variety of innovative solutions to water stakeholders which enables them to embrace a holistic and integrative management of water resources.
The innovative nature of our approach for addressing water quality assessment and management lies in the use of information technology for the storage, contextualization, processing and reporting of spatiotemporal water quality data from various sources to the tap, with the aim of using the resulting information in a decision support context. Our solutions and expertise are applicable and adaptable to a wide variety of operational, legislative, local, regional and even global contexts.

entityDescription:
Institute of Physics is a public institute whose main activities constitute scientific research in theoretical and experimental physics.
Institute of Physics was founded in 1960, as an institute devoted to scientific research in solid state physics and physics of ionized gases. Although a solid part of nowadays’ activities may still be incorporated in such a classification, it is better to say that, taking into account their scope and range of subjects, today’s activities encompass various branches of physics, such as solid state physics, surface physics, statistical physics, biological physics, atomic and molecular physics, optical physics and plasma physics.
Besides Institute’s permanent goal to acquire as high level of research quality as possible, its mission includes also the efforts to ensure that the research enables the technology transfer to the industry standards through the foundation of spin-off companies. The third component of our activities is education. A large number of scientists of the Institute participate in education of students both through the supervision of graduate and PhD theses and through teaching and undergraduate and graduate studies on Croatian universities.1
Mission
The Institute of Physics is dedicated to perform high quality basic research in physics as a prerequisite for the process of technology and knowledge transfer so as to give a notable, sustainable and socially responsible contribution to the development of Croatia, the region and EU.
Vision
- A scientific institution adopting the highest international standards in research.
- An institution which in cooperation with other national, regional or international institutions carries out complex research programmes in accord with the national and EU scientific strategies.
- An institution which through the various centres of excellence and user laboratories provides infrastructure and intra- and extra-institutional expertise for highest quality research.
- National research centre providing the stakeholders assisted access to technologies, knowledge and skills developed at the Institute.
- An innovation centre developing and transferring technology based on the results of its own research.
- An institution where the young people are educated and trained for the acceptance of emerging technologies in the course of active research.
- An organization which manages its large educational potentials in a systematic and socially responsible manner (preparation, storage and dissemination of the various educational contents).
- An institution with well developed national, regional and international cooperation and integrated in the ERA.
Values
- The Institute is dedicated to the requirements of highest quality fundamental and applied research as indispensable ingredients of the cultural, educational and economical foundations of the society.
- The Institute adheres to the notion that creativity and curiosity are the basic driving forces of top quality research which enables breakthroughs and innovative solutions to the problems addressed in science.
- The Institute adheres to the notion that is possible and necessary to develop more prosperous and competitive economy on the basis of scientific achievements.
- The Institute shall adhere to the highest ethical and professional standards in all aspects of its activities.
- The Institute takes the obligation to manage the resources at its disposal in a responsible and professional manner.

entityName: University of Zagreb, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture
entityDescription:
The Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Naval Architecture (UNIZAG FSB) has an almost century-old tradition – it is the successor to the Royal Technical College founded in 1919. Since then UNIZAG FSB has been one of the Croatian leading institutions in education, science and expertise in the fields of mechanical engineering and naval architecture, and for the last two decades in the field of aeronautical engineering too. Generations of engineers have been taught effectively by the Faculty’s teaching staff, who are also responsible for carrying out lifelong learning programmes for experts who are in the forefront of the development of economy and can generate ideas for further development. The staff, who collaborate with numerous academic institutions in Croatia and abroad and with the industry, have undoubtedly contributed to a high standing the Faculty has in the international academic community and in the industry. With the aim of maintaining this good reputation and of achieving the best possible results in teaching, research and professional activities the Faculty has adopted its Development Strategy 2014-2025. The teaching, research and professional activities include our recent achievements in the well-established fields (engineering design, naval architecture, aeronautical engineering, energy engineering, thermal and process engineering, IC engines and motor vehicles, manufacturing technologies, industrial engineering, materials engineering), and in the new and emerging fields of science and technology (computer engineering and simulations, mechatronics and robotics, medical engineering, nanotechnologies, military engineering, metrology, quality assurance and management). Many Faculty’s activities are carried
out in the laboratories that are specialized for various fields. After years of continuous improvement six well-equipped laboratories are accredited to EN ISO and are holders of the Croatian national standards. About ten student associations are the Faculty’s valuable asset. entityName: Centre Internacional de Mètodes Numèrics a l'Enginyeria (CIMNE)
entityDescription:
The International Centre for Numerical Methods in Engineering (CIMNE) is a research organization created in 1987 at the heart of the prestigious Technical University of Catalonia (UPC) as a partnership between the Government of Catalonia and UPC, in cooperation with UNESCO. The aim of CIMNE is the development of numerical methods and computational techniques for advancing knowledge and technology in engineering and applied sciences. The ultimate goal of CIMNE is to become an international reference centre and leader in computational mechanics, through achieving excellence in all the activities carried out by the centre. In December 2019 becameone of the six“Centre for Excellence Severo Ochoa”accredited by the Spanish State Research Agency (attachedtotheSpanishMinistry of Science, Innovation and Universities).
CIMNE’s headquarters are located at the heart of the Technical University of Catalonia (UPC) in Barcelona. CIMNE has also premises at different buildings in several campus of the UPC. CIMNE has also offices in Spain (Madrid, Castelldefels, Terrassa and Lleida). In 2005 CIMNE started its international expansion and since then has created the international branchesCIMNE Iber (Non-profit Foundation in Salta, Argentina)andCIMNE USA (Non-profit Corporation in Washington DC, USA). The centre has also strong links with the most renowned scientific institutions in Singapore and China.
CIMNE employs some 250 scientists and engineers who work in the different offices of CIMNE around the world. CIMNE has also established a network of 30Classrooms in partnership with Universities in Spain and 11 Latin American countries.

The research and technology development (RTD) activities of CIMNE cover a wide spectrum of topics ranging from classical engineering fields such as civil, mechanic, environmental, naval, marine and offshore, food, telecommunication and bio-medical engineering, computer sciences and applied sciences such as material sciences bio-medicine, computational physics, nature, social and economic sciences and multimedia sciences, among others.

Over its history, CIMNE has taken part in over 2,000 RTD projects in cooperation with some 500 companies, universities and research Centres worldwide.

The RTD activities of CIMNE are complemented by education and training activities via Master Courses, short courses and seminars and CIMNE Coffee talks. CIMNE scientists supervise doctorate students in cooperation with several universities in Spain and worldwide.
CIMNE has an own Publications Department in charge of publishing books, monographs, research reports and technical reports. Besides, CIMNE also has a Congress Department that organizes international conferences and workshops in the different areas of CIMNE. It has organized 150 conferences since 1987.
CIMNE has a vocation for transferring the scientific and technical outputs from RTD projects to the industrial sector. This is effectively carried out in cooperation with companies from different sectors that exploit and market the CIMNE technology. CIMNE has actively promoted the creation of spin-off companies, some of them totally or partially owned by CIMNE, which play an important role in the industrialization and exploitation of CIMNE technology.
CIMNE maintains close cooperation links with many universities and RTD Centres in the field of computational engineering and sciences worldwide. CIMNE has access to the computing facilities of several supercomputer Centres in Spain and Europe.
